items.title: 这款游戏曾被称为国产《暗黑2》，网游版十万人在线硬刚韩游

content.v: 2001年，陈天桥揣着仅有的30万美元，飞了一趟韩国，拿下了《传奇》在中国内地的代理权。
陈天桥赌赢了，但中国游戏行业，从那一刻起，走上了一条被韩游统治的路。
2002年国内运营的74款网游里，韩国游戏36款，占了48.65%，而中国内地制作的只有16款，占21.63%。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/ohNVFTbudjerjEz.png!a-3-854x.png
更扎心的是利润，韩国开发商通过版权费和利益分成，拿走了中国网游市场总销售额的40%左右，从盈利角度看，占到整个产业盈利的60%。
说白了，韩游吃肉，国产喝汤。代理模式门槛低、来钱快，但命根子攥在别人手里，处处受制于人。“自立自强”这四个字，成了国产游戏很长一段时间里的主旋律。
X博士认为，国产游戏起步虽晚，但后劲更足。像2004年诞生的《刀剑OL》，就是当年抗韩的“抗韩先锋”。公测不久之后，它就收获了10万人同时在线的好成绩，给国产网游打了个样。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/uAwTRNbudjeriEh.png!a-3-854x.png
在敢打敢拼的排头兵带领下，大部队被激励起来，国产游戏最终迎来了百花齐放的春天。
那么，这款“抗韩”游戏是如何诞生的？又是怎么在韩游中杀出重围？X博士带大家一起回顾一下！
划重点一：10万人同时在线硬刚韩游
《刀剑OL》的前身单机游戏《刀剑封魔录》，2002年发售，被玩家叫“国产暗黑2”。
刀剑封魔录
角色扮演, 动作, ARPG
那柄刀剑，彻底被封存在了中国网游发展的历史长河之中。
查看更多 立即下载
游戏素质没得说，游戏连续三天登顶美国Gamespot角色扮演类游戏排行榜，和一众国际大作打得有来有回。
虽然被称为国产暗黑2，但这游戏和暗黑完全不是一回事，暗黑是让你刷装备堆数值，刀剑让你“打”。格挡、闪避、连招编辑，一套操作下来几百连击不在话下，手感放在整个ARPG品类里都是独一档。
游戏虽然口碑好，但在盗版横行的年代，单机游戏的生存还是一个大问题，于是开发商转向做起了网游，这才有了后续的《刀剑OL》。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/cfzMHBbudjerhwu.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
从2003年12月起，《刀剑OL》先后开启了封测和四轮内测。这四轮测试，测的不只是服务器稳不稳，更是玩家认不认。
凭借与市面上韩游截然不同的硬核格斗体验，《刀剑OL》在玩家群体里迅速攒起了口碑，仅内测阶段，就有超过万玩家抢先体验。
一万人在今天看不算什么，但在2003年底，一款还没正式上线的国产网游能靠口碑聚起这个量级的测试玩家，本身就很难得。
当然，游戏能打是一回事，能不能让更多人知道是另一回事。而在宣传这件事上，搜狐是真下了血本。
2004年4月，搜狐在全国范围内铺开了一场叫“刀剑英雄会”的线下活动。
不是在一两个城市搞搞见面会就完事，而是地毯式推进，各城市网吧同步组织玩家试玩和对抗赛，把《刀剑OL》直接塞进了线下玩家的视野里。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/hwbDMIbudjergok.png!a-3-854x.png
两个月后，搜狐把阵仗拉到了北京居庸关长城。
2004年6月3日，《刀剑Online》新闻发布会在长城脚下举行。
搜狐老板张朝阳亲自登台站台，即兴打了一套拳术，还请来了当红歌手孙楠担任游戏主题音乐代言人，孙楠专门为游戏创作了武侠风格主题曲《刀剑英雄》。
一场发布会，集齐了门户掌舵人站台和一线歌手献声，这在当时的网游圈相当罕见的大阵仗。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/YEqasJbudjeretE.png!a-3-854x.png
一个月后，《刀剑Online》正式公测。半小时内首批15个服务器全红，搜狐当天下午两点紧急加开5组新服，公测两小时内创下国产游戏公测加服的纪录。
在公测后短短几天内，同时在线飙升到10万人。在韩游统治的年代，《刀剑OL》属实是替国产网游争了一口气下来。
公测成功之后，真正的考验才刚开始。
最初的《刀剑OL》走的是点卡收费制度，但在不久后的免费游戏机制的带动下，《刀剑OL》顺应时代潮流，同步也做了一个大的给变——更名为《刀剑英雄》，并宣布永久免费。
刀剑英雄
武侠, 半写实, 2.5D, 即时, PK, 副本, 道具收费, 怀旧
《刀剑英雄》是由像素软件研发搜狐畅游运营的一款武侠类游戏。该游戏在04年发行，至今在网络游戏圈子里已经成了一代经典。华丽的技能，创意的连招，自制的武器，这些新颖的元素为玩家们创造了一个神奇的世界。
查看更多 立即下载
之前要花钱的，现在能免费白嫖，游戏的口碑和玩家人数自然迎来了一波爆发，于是《刀剑英雄》也沿着免费模式，一直持续到现在。
划重点二：武侠竞技格斗MMO，格斗爱好者的天堂
如果只用一句话定义《刀剑英雄》，那就是“首款武侠竞技格斗网游”，这也是它吸引人的地方。
在韩游练级刷怪千篇一律的年代，《刀剑英雄》的战斗真是玩出花来了，它不是站桩按技能等冷却，这是要你真正“搓”的游戏。
《刀剑英雄》核心在于“搓连招”的爽感，因为连招在第7、10、15、20、27、35的打击位置上是有攻击加成的，所以连招被分为两类。
一个是以7连或10连的小连招，消耗精气少，利用加成快速打怪。
另一个则是追求高连击数和高杀伤力的大连招，用于竞技，或打怪以造成二次掉宝。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/EzOmudbudjerbno.gif!a-3-854x.gif
当然，《刀剑英雄》的格斗不是无脑连招，破绽系统才是真正拉开高手和菜鸟差距的地方。
每个人在竞技开始时破绽值都是0，随着各种操作破绽会增加，不同的技能增加的破绽不同，攻击被对方防住的话破绽增加很多。
当破绽到100的时候人物身上会有红色气流笼罩，这时候如果被打中会造成一段时间硬直，另一方可以趁机打出一套大连招。
所以竞技的基本思想之一就是，抓住对方破绽满的时间给予其强有力的打击，并设法不让对方抓住自己的破绽。
在攻防之间找到时机，打出一套连招，屏幕上的连击数字一路飙升，对面血条直接见底，这种爽感是站桩游戏给不了的。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/UjhgNDbudjeqFDA.png!a-3-854x.png
而那么多年下来，《刀剑英雄》的聪明之处在于它没有让格斗停留在单挑里，而是用版本更新把格斗基因一次次往外扩。
比如2010年5月，《烽火楚天》推出大规模城战。外城对峙、内城肉搏、密道偷袭三线并进。这是把《刀剑英雄》的格斗基因从“单挑”扩展到了“大规模团战”。一个人连招搓得再溜，城战里也得学会站位、配合、听指挥。
到了2012年，《群雄逐鹿》资料片开放跨服PK。不同服务器的玩家终于站上了同一个擂台，游戏的竞技属性被推向又一个高点，更在于它重新洗牌了竞技场的对抗关系。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/JcveclbudjeqFbb.jpg!a-3-854x.jpg
版本在变，玩法在扩，但“竞技格斗”的根基从来没动过。
那些年，《刀剑online》保持着每年至少一部资料片的更新节奏，玩家社群也在这过程中逐渐形成了自己的生态。正是这种对竞技格斗的长期坚持，让《刀剑英雄》聚集了一批极为忠实的玩家群体。

items.title: 正惊解梗：国产低配版暴雪？做的游戏没人玩，却靠拍AI短剧火爆全球！

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/tniDDObuedasyiy.gif!a-3-854x.gif
新梗不断，看懂不难；前因后果，一次扒透！
大家好，这里是正惊游戏，我是爱吃瓜的正惊小弟。
最近互联网又火了哪些新梗？又有什么游戏黑话看得你一头雾水？玩梗也要玩得明明白白！
话不多说，今日咱们要来拆解的梗是——海水过滤器。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/cmgXlabuedauclq.png!a-3-854x.png
不知道你最近刷短视频时，有没有被海水过滤器硬控过30秒。
可能只是随手刷到的末日海上求生，可能只是有个秃头大叔在排队领鸡蛋，甚至可能只是个平平无奇的吃席画面……
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/OVzLpYbuedauaef.png!a-3-854x.png
手指刚碰到屏幕想划走，结果下一秒，剧情急转直下。
一个粗犷的男声就怼到你脸上，开局一定要选海水过滤器！有了它，年入百万不是梦，妹子排队倒贴，高级庇护所随便搬，人生一键重启。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/DjCfkcbuedatDaa.png!a-3-854x.png
蛤？？？海水过滤器，迎娶白富美，高级庇护所，这都什么跟什么啊。
还没缓过神，魔性台词第二轮又来了，开局一定要选海水过滤器，三分钟一局，巨爽巨解压，疯狂水世界，启动！
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/IQPrYtbuedatyvc.png!a-3-854x.png
不是哥们，这玩意到底是个啥？？？怎么一天天的，要在我眼前晃个八万遍？
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/xIgRyObuedatxau.png!a-3-854x.png
从工业神器到抽象名梗，它到底经历了什么
说个很多人不知道的，海水过滤器不是游戏瞎编的，现实里真有这东西。
而且它的发展历史，比大多数人想象中早得多。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/wKTfJBbuedatwdy.png!a-3-854x.png
公元前1500年，古埃及人就开始拿砂石、布料折腾海水，想滤掉杂质。
1671年，英国学者罗伯特・培根开始尝试用沙层过滤，来实现海水脱盐；到了1950年前后，美国加州大学洛杉矶分校的科学家搞出了反渗透技术，用一层薄膜实现了净化。
最终在1965年，全球第一家反渗透海水淡化工厂，在加州正式落地。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/NStIAsbuedatxiD.png!a-3-854x.png
但，现实里的海水淡化，没那么浪漫。
装一套设备，能耗要算，膜寿命要算，维护成本要算，一个岛一个厂，前前后后折腾好几年，才能每天净化几百吨淡水。
对比来看，在广告中出现的海水过滤器，反倒是更像一种玄天之宝。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/tNVaPVbuedatwui.png!a-3-854x.png
对，就像是修仙小说里那种，能让凡人逆天改命的顶级法宝。
在海洋淹没陆地的末世里，一口干净的淡水可是比黄金都珍贵的东西，谁开局能拿到海水过滤器，谁就能搬进更好的庇护所，迎娶白富美，从此走上人生巅峰。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/LxGwDrbuedatwez.png!a-3-854x.png
可光有法宝还不够，还得有配得上它的天选之人。
没错，他就是我们每天都能在短视频里刷到的那个男人——肥强，一个穿背心的光头仔。
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/nOgfkBbuedaubwv.png!a-3-854x.png
肥强在末日下的每一天，过得都特别有规律。
出门装大款，被人打假，吃瘪。回出租屋，被合租室友欺负，吃瘪。跟朋友吹牛，被当场拆穿，吃瘪……
https://i.17173cdn.com/2fhnvk/YWxqaGBf/cms3/LzYUzCbuedauagg.png!a-3-854x.png
总之，就是各种吃瘪，各种被狗眼看人低，受尽人间屈辱。
然后肥强发愤图强，朝天大喊一声——我这就打捞海水过滤器，搬去更好的庇护所，疯狂水世界，启动！
至此，广告结束。
说实话，就跟红果短剧差不多，这套路固定到令人发指，但你就是忍不住想看他下一集怎么吃瘪，又是怎么逆袭的。
刷着刷着，还真给让玩意刷成日常番了。
更离谱的是，广告里的神器还自带版本更新的。
肥强手上的货，最早是台传了三代的尿液过滤器。祖传老物件，主打自产自销、循环利用，low到没眼看。
后来海水过滤器登场，肥强算是鸟枪换炮，终于用上正经装备了。
到了现在，直接进化到电鳗发电器，电鳗发电，绿色无污染，纯纯的新能源。
照这个趋势，下一步怕是该迭代到河豚造氧机了。
另外，这剧情的离谱程度，也堪称包罗万象。
怎么获得老丈人的认可，怎么在相亲局收获美人芳心，怎么搞定甲方赏识……
一集一个社会热点，一集一个过滤器解法，总有一款适合你。
就这样，靠着套公式的打法，肥强与海水过滤器，硬生生地把自己给捧成了很多人心目中的国漫巅峰。
甚至有“游戏一点不玩，广告一集不落”的网友真心实意地建议，要不咱干脆别做游戏了，改行做AI短剧得了。
你品品，一家游戏公司给游戏拍AI短剧做宣传，结果拍出来的短剧比游戏火，这不就是被游戏耽误的AI短剧公司吗。
那问题来了，造出海水过滤器这东西的《疯狂水世界》，赚钱嘛？

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261009/1791510964_831857_jpg_r.jpg

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261009/1791510967_204571_jpg_r.jpg
文章回顾此前评测时提到，Legion Go S握持舒适、续航较强，但当时售价偏高，性能也不及部分对比掌机。游戏表现仍有差异：借助画面升级工具，《一级方程式赛车》和《地平线：零之曙光》在中等画质下表现尚可；《黑神话：悟空》和《赛博朋克2077》即使使用同类工具，中等画质下运行仍较吃力。

另一个版本搭载Ryzen Z1 Extreme处理器，配备1TB存储和32GB内存，预装SteamOS，文中列出的百思买价格为1000美元。两款Legion Go S的配置不同，比较价格时需分清版本。

content.v: 1992年推出的初代《真人快打》以真人演员动作制作角色， 血腥 的终结技也让它卷入美国游戏 暴力 争论。美国参议院在1993年和1994年的相关听证会上，直接谈及了这款游戏。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261009/1791510641_923722_jpg_r.jpg
初代《真人快打》是一款一对一街机格斗游戏。当时，格斗游戏在街机厅受到关注，这款作品的角色、特殊招式和终结技也给玩家留下了印象。回顾文章的作者同时认为，与其他格斗游戏相比，它的动作显得较为僵硬。
作者认为，真人影像让游戏中的暴力场面在当时更具冲击力，也使《真人快打》成为家长、政治人物和媒体讨论游戏内容时提及的作品。游戏行业随后建立的ESRB分级制度，与当时围绕暴力内容的争议也有关联。
这场争论也反映在家用机移植版本中：超级任天堂版删去了血液效果，世嘉Genesis版则允许玩家输入隐藏指令开启相关内容。作者认为，初代作品由此确立了系列独特的格斗游戏形象，也成为后来讨论游戏内容边界时常被引用的例子。

content.v: Xbox负责人阿莎·夏尔马在内部会议上表示，Xbox业务经历同比下滑后已重回增长。她还将下一代Xbox Helix描述为“设备家族”，其中会有一款主机。
这份内部会议记录由Windows Central取得，该站称已通过可靠消息源确认记录真实。夏尔马称，年初Xbox的游戏时长、玩家数量和收入都曾下降；如今游戏时长已经稳定，业务重回增长，她预计增长势头将延续。她还表示，Xbox品牌的正面评价一年内上升了30%，几款新作的开局表现“强劲”。

items.title: 尊界回应刹车断裂要高于国标 懂车帝否认暴力测试
items.summary: 此前引发全网大量网友围观讨论的尊界汽车制动踏板支架断裂争议事件，如今品牌方和发起测试的懂车帝双方都已经先后公开发声给出了各…

content.v: 快科技10月9日消息，此前引发全网大量网友围观讨论的尊界汽车制动踏板支架断裂争议事件，如今品牌方和发起测试的懂车帝双方都已经先后公开发声给出了各自的回应。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610090932205257.png
尊界汽车率先发布了关于制动踏板支架底座相关问题的官方情况说明，明确指出制动系统直接关系到每一位用户的出行安全，品牌方面高度重视相关测试视频引发的全网关切。
尊界汽车的整套制动系统，宣称是按照高于国家现行标准、高于汽车行业标准的要求完成了全流程开发与验证工作，自首批车辆正式交付用户以来，在所有用户的实际日常使用场景中，还没有发生过任何一起制动踏板支架底座断裂的故障案例，用户安全永远是品牌运营的第一优先级。
品牌方同时表态，哪怕相关情况发生在非标准的极端测试工况下，他们依然希望为用户提供更高的安全冗余，接下来会立刻进一步优化该部件的结构设计，并且为所有已经交付到用户手上的车辆提供免费升级更换相关部件的服务。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610090932275235.png
同时品牌还会对全系列相关部件的设计验证标准、试验测试边界与全链路生产质量管理流程开展系统性的复核与补强，持续迭代完善整套安全体系，也感谢广大用户对尊界汽车的关注和监督。
尊界的官方声明发布之后，懂车帝相关负责人也很快针对事件细节给出了回应，他们表示日常实测中做的百公里刹车实验根本算不上什么极端工况，很多普通车主在高速驾驶需要紧急避险的时候都会用到大力刹车操作，是所有汽车公开实测里最基础的标准测试科目之一。
本次测试节目里出现的这款百万级MPV制动踏板支架断裂的情况，在他们过往数千台车型的测试经历里属于首次出现，而且连续三台测试车都在同一位置出现了相似的断裂现象，这说明相关部件确实存在一定的安全隐患。
针对网上不少人质疑他们做暴力测试的说法，懂车帝明确辟谣，网传所谓远超常规水平的暴力测试根本不存在，测试过程里模拟的只是普通驾驶员遇到紧急状况时的正常大力制动操作。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610090932374539.png
另外大家注意到的国标GB 7258‑2026也就是机动车运行安全技术条件，是今年8月27日才正式公布，要等到明年7月1日才会正式落地实施，届时才会替代旧版国标，而尊界V800的发布时间要早于8月27日，开发阶段根本不可能按照当时还没公开的新标准来做设计参考。
根据现行的汽车行业标准QC/T 788‑2018也就是汽车踏板装置性能要求及台架试验方法，对制动踏板的受力要求是1500±20N的纵向力，完成保持5秒再释放的循环操作5次就算合格。
懂车帝的测试视频里没有提及前两辆尊界V800刹车踏板断裂瞬间的踏板力数值，只公开展示了第三辆测试车的相关数据，第一次刹停时踏板力达到1596N，刹车踏板完好没有异常，第二次测试踏板力到1612N的时候，刹车踏板支架直接发生断裂，两次的数值都只是略超过现行行业标准的要求。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610090935401772.png
很多网友随后也扒出了海外传统车企的相关安全设计规范，公开资料显示通用汽车在2007版的GMW15396工程规范里，就已经把刹车踏板踩踏方向的极端载荷设定为2700N，保时捷MSB平台的要求更严苛，刹车踏板的断裂载荷要达到3000N，还要在零下35摄氏度、常温和80摄氏度三种极端温度条件下分别完成全部测试。
针对之前网络上流传很广的4589N踏板力离谱数值，懂车帝也专门做了澄清，这个数字完全不是实际测试出来的数据，是高速摄像机拍摄实验画面时，因为摄像机和检测设备的液晶屏刷新帧率不一样，拍下来的屏幕数字跳动出现残影，被部分网友截图之后当成真实数据到处传播，属于完全不实的谣言，真实的测试峰值踏板力就是他们公开的1612N，踏板力达到峰值之后数值就迅速回落了。

演示展示了猎人梦境、约瑟夫卡诊所和雅南中心等场景，并对比了开启与关闭神经渲染时的画面。RTX Remix主要面向采用较早图形管线的游戏。若将《血源》整个渲染流程改造成旧式DirectX 9管线，可能遇到兼容性问题，并增加绘制调用负担。gabdeg因此将环境中的静态几何数据转换为RTX Remix可使用的格式；人物等动态几何数据则仍从经shadPS4运行的游戏直接传入。
gabdeg认为，这种做法或许能为其他通常不兼容RTX Remix的游戏提供参考，但目前仍有技术问题尚未解决。作者暂未公布发布时间；视频也不意味着官方移植版或完整增强模组已经可供下载。

items.title: 《影之刃零》承认大量借鉴魂 但真不是魂类游戏
items.summary: 《影之刃零》自公布以来，常被玩家拿来与魂系游戏比较

content.v: 《影之刃零》自公布以来，常被玩家拿来与魂系游戏比较。总监梁其伟（Soulframe）在近期采访中回应了这一话题，明确表示本作并非魂类游戏，而是一个融合多种类型的混合体。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610090915134100.png

梁其伟用一个金字塔来概括游戏的结构。底层是RPG系统，包含支线任务、地图、图标引导和NPC对话驱动的线索，地图不会堆满标记，保持简洁直接。中间层是复杂的关卡设计，他说这部分“大量借鉴了魂系游戏”。最顶层才是高速连击战斗，灵感来自传统动作砍杀游戏。他用冰山比喻：“高速战斗只是露出水面的那一角，我们之前的预告和试玩几乎全在展示这部分，导致很多人以为这是一款纯线性砍杀游戏。实际玩到才会发现，叙事比重很大，探索也很深。”

content.v: SCS Software公布了《 欧洲卡车模拟2 》待推出的Coaches扩展中的观光任务。玩家将驾驶巴士，接送假日出游的乘客往返景点，行程从巴士站出发，并在游览结束后返回出发地。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261009/1791508703_880675_jpg_r.jpg
观光任务的目的地包括自然景观、城市中心和开放参观的工业设施。景点的知名度与规模各不相同，行程长短也会随之变化。部分景点设有开放时间，玩家安排路线时还需考虑抵达时刻。
抵达目的地后，游戏会通过观景位置和简短过场展示乘客看到的景点。许多地点还附有简短介绍，供玩家了解其背景。游览结束后，司机需要安全地将乘客送回出发地。
开发团队表示，观光任务的时间安排比合同任务更从容，玩家可以在途中欣赏风景。与卡车货运、快速任务和合同任务相比，这类任务换成了接送乘客的巴士行程，也要求玩家兼顾去程、回程及部分景点的开放时间。

content.v: 由BetaDwarf开发的全新撤离ARPG《龙窟破坏者》Demo现已上线Steam。在今天的3i发布会上，Square Enix 宣布将正式作为《龙窟破坏者》的全球发行商，Demo现已上线，并预告了10月15日开启的PvPvE测试。
https://image.gcores.com/b9c1bddec2c000d227372107e466e2ce-3840-2160.jpeg
《龙窟破坏者》是一款奇幻冒险题材的多人撤离ARPG游戏。玩家将扮演破阵者，建造据点，收集塑造玩法的远古神器，独自或与好友探索被腐化的世界，用策略与技巧踏上通往龙之宝库的道路。游戏支持单人/多人PvE与PvPvE模式。
https://image.gcores.com/e7d3d2c4b47398f167eb8230ed19a298-1920-1080.png
在Demo版本里，游戏提供了2名可选择的破阵者，玩家将可以在2种PvE难度下，独自或与好友游玩第一章地图与任务主线。而在10月15日即将到来的PvPvE测试中，玩家将能游玩更多破阵者，与其他玩家进行PvP战斗，赢下对局完成撤离。
https://image.gcores.com/e22f68a528be478b6348a0df96b3b76d-1920-1080.png
BetaDwarf也成立了官方账号并入驻了中国社区，作为一家立足社区运营打造多人游戏的开发商，BetaDwarf希望通过《龙窟破坏者》为中国玩家带来全新的游戏体验。
https://image.gcores.com/9441c0140f0e31432e7e8c7b3eab5235-1351-562.png
游戏介绍
探索并征服 一个瞬息万变的世界
踏上征途，参与一个个紧张又刺激的任务，这些挑战会根据其他玩家和 NPC 的行动动态展开。有人或许会污染大片区域，另一人可能正在解锁秘密洞穴，还有人或许即将启动古老仪式。每个人都有自己的计划，让每次游戏都充满了机遇与挑战。是抓住机遇还是避开威胁，取决于你的选择！
及时调整和灵活应对来自幻形灵的挑战
幻形灵属于变形者中一支邪恶、混乱且难以预测的派系，它们正在蜂拥而至入侵龙窟。这些幻形灵由先进的AI或其他玩家控制，使得它们的行为极具不确定性。你将在游戏中不断做出令人兴奋的决策，选择是避开它们、发起攻击，甚至暂时与它们合作，以最佳策略完成你的计划。
磨练技术，完善战略
技术决定一切。尽管大多数攻击都是惩罚性的，但都可以通过技术躲避。当敌人发动攻击时，他们会暴露出破绽，如果时机把握得当，你可以轻松造成双倍伤害。然而，并不是所有战斗都值得参与，你需要在采取冒险行动前权衡利弊。在紧张的探索过程中，每个角落都可能暗藏埋伏，甚至发生史诗般的多组混战，每次遭遇都需要你迅速反应，快速决策。
升级与试炼
《龙窟破坏者》提供多种成长路径和自定义选项，以匹配您的喜好和游戏风格。您可以选择各种英雄，解锁并装备增益效果，加强英雄技能；搜寻或制作物品以习得新技能，增强实力；唤醒神器，解锁隐藏的神秘力量。通过这些，您会变得更强大，甚至学会新技能，帮助您以新的方式穿越世界，比如利用植物翻越障碍。
加入龙窟守护，迎接极限挑战
身为龙窟守护者的一员，您需要保护世界免受古老黑暗力量的威胁。沉浸在丰富的故事情节中，与各种NPC互动，他们会给您派发任务，逐步探索世界，直至龙窟。不断挑战自己，争夺玩家排名，通过完成各种挑战来攀升至榜单前列！

content.v: 今年 9 月，《影之刃零》在北京举办了一场线下试玩会。
我也有幸提前一窥这款备受玩家期待的「功夫朋克」大作。作为一款武侠题材的快节奏动作游戏，本作在音乐上带给了我一种自成一派的独特体验。而这些，自然要归功于系列游戏的音乐总监，也是我们机核的老朋友——薄彩生。
从 18 年前的独立游戏《雨血》，到后来的《影之刃》系列，再到如今这部 3A 级别的《影之刃零》，薄彩生的音乐一直是这个系列重要的组成部分。 借着这次难得的机会，我们也有幸再一次采访了薄彩生老师：从他与制作人梁其伟（S）长达十余年的合作开始，聊到了本次面对 3A 级制作时，音乐设计带来的挑战，以及玩家们最关心的——在游戏的音乐中，有哪些等待大家去发现的惊喜。
https://image.gcores.com/48a3cda52f9b1e09b17260fad08653a0-1023-677.png
那么话不多说，就让我们正式开始！
一封邮件，和 18 年的合作
Jerry: 薄彩生老师，据我所知，你和《影之刃零》的制作人梁其伟已经合作超过 15 年了。趁着这次《影之刃零》，算是这个系列的又一次重启，你愿不愿意再讲讲当初合作的开端？
薄彩生: 我自己算了一下，这场合作从最开始算起，可能有 18 年了吧。
https://image.gcores.com/d3de7196ee0d1be95a64154a1b8758eb-1920-1151.jpg
我记得那还是 08 年北京奥运会的时候，我还在读高中。当时的电脑上没什么好玩的游戏，我就到网上找独立游戏玩，磕磕碰碰最后遇到了国产独立游戏《雨血》。我从小就学乐器，也喜欢写点儿东西，但都不太成熟。等我玩完《雨血》，它在结尾跳出来一个邮箱，就是制作人 S 自己的联系方式——我想，那就碰碰运气吧，就给他发了封邮件，附上了我做的一个音乐小样。
当时的他还在耶鲁读书，把我的曲子放给外国室友听，大家都觉得挺好。他当时正在做续作《雨血 2》，我们两个一拍即合，也没多想，就直接开始合作了。
https://image.gcores.com/3cf30c133c50a4655d6af8725fd819ce-1203-677.png
Jerry: 18 年这么长的合作，你觉得维持这种信任关系最重要的因素是什么？
薄彩生: 最重要的因素就是他不咋管我（笑）。他觉得只要最后做出来的音乐 OK，那就行。在这方面他很放任，甚至有点宠溺。
作为制作人，他从手游到单机，要考虑的东西越来越多。独立游戏时期他就没有怎么管过音乐，到现在就更没时间了——这对我来说反而是件好事。不受别的事情影响，我就专心把自己的音乐做好，在技巧上慢慢磨练、慢慢提高。合作就这么一路维持下来了。
Jerry: 我觉得这也是因为你是一个自我要求比较高的人。
薄彩生: 那肯定。我得匹配这个游戏的质量，而且做 3A 就更不能掉链子。做 3A 这件事情，我们 2017 年的时候就聊过了。虽然《影之刃零》正式启动已经是很久之后，但从那会儿开始，我就有意识地磨练自己。
不回避地讲，我一直想成为最顶尖的配乐人，这就是我的人生理想。从这一点上来看，遇到《影之刃》就像是命运的召唤一样——这是我的幸运。
https://image.gcores.com/fd17a635800ff4a926b44dc0e285d62f-1186-677.png
这次，不只是作曲
Jerry: 从之前的《影之刃》系列到现在的《影之刃零》，这之间的规格是一个巨大的升级。那么在规格上去之后，这份工作对你来说最大的变化是什么？
薄彩生: 在 2022 年刚开始聊《影之刃零》的时候，我完全没想过接下来会遇到什么。当时我还以为它可能就是一个再大一点的手游，是"《影之刃 4》"，那时候我觉得只要延续自己的风格就行了。
但真正做起来才发现，当一个游戏要聚焦在叙事和单人体验上的时候，音乐的创作角度是完全不一样的。
https://image.gcores.com/89298ef4b1dcd74e722fc7670bd5d4bc-1186-677.png
举一个例子。在手游时期，我们是怎么合作的？当时的关卡策划只需要给我一份设计文档，注明"这是一张新地图，这是地图 A，这是地图 B"，我就可以按照它大概的样子进行作曲了。但是当这件事情的规格到达了 3A、到了以叙事为核心的单机体验的时候，这套东西就完全失效了。
仅凭一张场景图，我哪知道游戏在这里头要发生什么？现在我首先需要知道的是：玩家带着怎样的心情、怎样的心流进入这个场景？他们探索时会发生什么？会遇上什么样的敌人？敌人的出招速度有多快？这些按照之前的交流方式是完全传达不了的——而它们才是现在游戏体验中最重要的部分。
所以后来我干脆说：“你们在关卡做完了之后，录一段录像给我。到处跑一跑、看一看，甚至被怪物砍两刀。” 这样我才能以一个玩家的身份，去体会主角现在是什么心情。然后我再依此给他们做声音设计。 这和之前写曲子的逻辑完全不一样，需要频繁地和关卡策划来回沟通：这些音乐要用在哪里？从哪里循环？到哪里停止？从什么时候再接续上？这些都要进行整体的设计。
https://image.gcores.com/69c7f5aeec648f67dbad4356defce2c3-1186-677.png
所以在这一点上，我的工作有点像是"音乐导演"。我发现这是做叙事型游戏、尤其是单机叙事型游戏最重要的一件事，也是这次对我而言最大的考验。
贯穿始终的旋律
Jerry: 你之前在机核的节目里聊过《碟中谍》《星球大战》这类时间跨度很长的 IP，讲了它们在续作和外传中是怎么处理音乐的。
现在《影之刃》也成了一个跨度很长的系列，在做《影之刃零》的音乐时，你也会去考虑之前这个系列的各种旋律吗？
薄彩生: 这次的旋律完全延续自《雨血》的时期。本作的女主角小葵，她的旋律就是我在 18 年前高中时候所写的。所谓的传承，就是旋律。只不过这一次，在"旋律什么时候应该响起"的问题上，我努力尽到了一个音乐导演的职责——让不同的旋律在该用的地方用好，这才能带给大家最爽的体验。
就像我在机核的那期节目里提到的一样："动机"就是一小段旋律，它在推进主线剧情时尤为重要。同一个动机会在关键的剧情里反复响起，这里面包括左殇、小葵，也包括魂自己的旋律，大家在玩的时候可以留意感受。随着游戏进程往后，剧情逐渐铺开，各种熟悉的旋律会越来越多地响起，在重要的剧情节点调动玩家的情绪。
https://image.gcores.com/a74607f8d86ab459ae570cbde6a17197-1023-677.png
Jerry: 既然我们提到了剧情，我也很好奇——这次的主线讲述的是一个只有 66 天生命的人独自对抗武林的故事。这样一个基调，在音乐上又该怎么去呈现？
薄彩生: 其实用音乐来概括这件事本身就非常复杂。我希望这个音乐既是个人的，也是宏大的。
我举一个例子吧。这个游戏是多结局的，当玩家打到一个比较关键的结局时，会有一个音乐适时地响起。在这方面，我们做了着重的设计，希望这个音乐响起来的那一刻，能成为玩家这 20 多个小时游玩体验的总结，把整个情绪概括住。而我所有的设计、铺垫、小的巧思，都会在这最后一刻迎来最终的爆发。
我希望对声音设计和音乐感兴趣的玩家们，到最后能有一个完满的答案：这个游戏的作曲，不是把带感的东西随便散落在里面。虽然很多的支线 Boss 可能确实是怎么好听怎么来的，但在主线流程中，我希望玩家在听觉上有一条能够到达终点的路，一条贯穿整个旅程的听觉之路。当玩家走向决战、一直到打完，我希望大家在最后那一刻，在音乐上得到一种收束感。
https://image.gcores.com/8322dd1ad7578240548d83975e36e519-1920-1080.webp
音乐也可以先行
Jerry: 这次试玩中，我发现在几场 Boss 战里能明显地听到民乐器，而在很多地方，音乐又挺摇滚的。你好像一直很喜欢这种对撞的感觉。
薄彩生: 是的。这次混合了很多摇滚、电子还有金属。实话实说，我其实一直想做这样的东西。以前不敢这么做的原因之一是当时的能力不行——十几年前的我，把这些东西放在一起还是会显得突兀。这些年过去，我也自我升级了，能力提升了一些。
另一个重要原因是，游戏里的画面也会配合音乐来演出。我曾经跟 S 讨论过：如果某些部分的音乐做得太 high、速度比他们预想的快，他们甚至会为了音乐来调整 Boss 的出招频率。
在《影之刃》里，我们不想把音乐变成一个附加工种——像影视公司那样，等画面定剪了，再去考虑配乐的问题。我们希望游戏首先要玩得起来、要嗨，既要有交互，还要把音乐做好。这就需要一个双向的调整。正是因为这么多年的信任和合作，这个过程才会很顺畅。
https://image.gcores.com/ba35e79a2a334e15847509cd644937c3-1920-1080.webp
所以很多东西甚至是「音乐先行」的。比如一开始在设计某段游戏内容的时候 ，其实是我先写的音乐——虽然这段音乐最后没有被采用。
Jerry: 这是能说的吗？（汗）
薄彩生: 能，有啥不能说的？其实很多时候，音乐、战斗、画面都是相互启发的。我举一个例子：比如我给某段战斗的开场写了一段音乐，如果我希望这段音乐响得更久一点，我会和其他人说，你们能不能把这个人物给我调远一点——他多走 10 秒，我的音乐就能多响 10 秒，让情绪完整地抒发出来。很多时候我就直接在微信上这么说了。只要说得有道理，大家就觉得 OK。我想这也是因为我们已经合作了 18 年的缘故。
简单来说，我们想做的就是不断地、人为地去控制玩家的心流。作为 ARPG，大家喜欢快速的动作；那么在快速动作里，"停下来的部分"的音乐就更加重要。由我从源头来把控音乐的设计中的轻重缓急。嗨起来相对容易，有现成的范式：速度上去、鼓打起来、电吉他弹起来；难的是怎么把它降下来，然后再上去。
https://image.gcores.com/7d33e634488342db5f6dfcfe9c0d858b-1026-578.png
不过在经历了漫长的开发之后，我现在的创作理念是：不要太过珍惜自己的作品。在《影之刃零》里我做了很多民乐的新鲜尝试，有些也确实可能太过了，实在贴不上。在录音时，我和二胡老师、三弦老师都很喜欢这些东西，扔了怪可惜的，所以我们在计划要不要放进豪华版的原声集里。大家预购豪华版的话，里面有一个内置的音乐播放器，没准就能听到。
武侠的先锋精神
Jerry: 这次《影之刃零》的核心是功夫朋克。我们有着很丰富的功夫影视的历史。不知道这里面有没有哪部作品对你这次的创作产生了重要的影响？

薄彩生: 我觉得这次影响我的不是某一个具体的作品，而更多的是小时候看武侠电影时带来的那种震撼感。你想想以前的香港功夫电影，多先锋啊——他们在音乐上大量地用合成器，画面上用特效化妆和非常奇怪的角度，来打得很炫酷。还有像《六指琴魔》之类这样的设定。这在当时都是非常突破的。我们想延续的是这个精神，而不是某个作品的某个片段。我相信当时的功夫电影的创作者们和我们现在想的也差不多，大家都想做出自己没见过的东西。
https://image.gcores.com/f07da60193637aa00175e73f1d0363ef-1920-1080.webp
说得再抽象一点。现在的很多音乐创作在媒介上都有规范、有标准答案、有范式，比如超级英雄电影、特工片。大家可能在主旋律上不一样，但是在配器和演奏方式上都在趋同——这一方面是市场需要，另一方面也是商业电影发展这么多年找到的一个最佳路径。
但是功夫朋克没有一个稳定的范式。所以我的想法是：如果别人都这么写，我就偏不，看看自己能不能找到不同的方式。落到《影之刃零》上，不同的 Boss 用不同的方式渲染紧张感——一会儿是金属，一会儿是死嗓，一会儿是动次打次的节奏，还有突然切换的节拍。总之，我在想方设法地让玩家在听感上保持新鲜。
摸着石头过河
Jerry: 之前在节目里面曾经提到过，相比起好莱坞和欧美的 3A 游戏，我们在音乐领域的工业体系还相差很多。那时候你也说过，想要把自己的全身心放在配乐上。但是这次的《影之刃零》里，你好像是介入了方方面面的环节啊？

items.title: 《影之刃零》通关约30小时 极力避免通马桶 刷材料
items.summary: 本作完整通关时长约为25至30小时

content.v: 据DualShockers报道，《影之刃零》总监梁其伟（Soulframe）在近期采访中确认，本作完整通关时长约为25至30小时，前提是玩家不会卡在某个Boss上。
梁其伟在采访中详细阐述了团队对游戏时长的设计理念。他表示，团队更看重的是体验密度，而非游戏总长度。“我们极力避免让玩家重复劳动、刷资源，或在空旷无意义的地图上闲逛。”他进一步解释，这一理念在支线任务中体现得尤为明显——“每一个支线任务都与武侠幻想深度绑定，关乎功夫、杀戮、鲜血与钢铁。不是通马桶，也不是帮老奶奶找走丢的猫。每个支线都旨在丰富这个世界，让你感觉自己是个狠角色剑客。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610090854292011.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610090854303880.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610090854323566.png
即便玩家在某个Boss处卡住，体验也不会像传统魂系游戏那样令人挫败。由于游戏核心是RPG，玩家可以随时调整Build、切换武器套装、更换饰品来让战斗变得更容易。“你不必用同一套Build撞一百次墙，这就是它的美妙之处。”

items.title: 《影之刃零》动作小白爽玩 随便连按自动打出帅气操作
items.summary: 4Gamer编辑试玩了约5小时，随后又挑战了后期两名Boss，总计约6小时。

content.v: 在2026年9月于北京举行的试玩活动中，S-GAME邀请全球媒体提前体验了《影之刃零》的第一章内容。4Gamer编辑试玩了约5小时，随后又挑战了后期两名Boss，总计约6小时。最让他印象深刻的，是即便只是连按攻击键，主角“魂”也能打出行云流水般的招式，甚至自动触发处决演出。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610090822519952.png
本作的核心战斗围绕普通攻击（□键）与强攻（△键）展开，配合格挡（L1）和闪避（R1）。敌人的攻击以颜色区分：蓝光可格挡或精准弹反，成功后绕至敌人身后；红光则无法防御，只能闪避。然而，让试玩编辑惊讶的是，即便只是单纯连按□键，魂也会自动衔接各种招式，有时甚至打出处决动画。输入是否精准，并不影响画面中角色看起来像功夫片主角。在简单难度下，被多个敌人包围时，还会更频繁地触发华丽的群体攻击演出。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610090823009809.png

游戏提供30种主武器和25种副武器。十字键左切换武器时，杀气会完全恢复，但有冷却时间。这鼓励玩家在杀气耗尽时自然切换武器。每种武器都有独特招式，击败Boss后即可获得其武器。例如“锯齿钢”附带出血效果，“恐惧斧”可蓄力劈开盾牌和锁链，“猎人之链镰”能远距离攻击并勾住锚点开辟新路线。最特别的是“剑狂的断刃”——饮酒后进入微醺状态，所有攻击变为飞剑；再按L2进入烂醉状态，飞剑强化且自动闪避，但无法格挡，再次按下则释放无法防御的飞剑乱舞后恢复清醒。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610090823095062.png
探索部分同样充满武侠片的戏剧感。魂在攀爬梯子时会翻身跃起，翻越墙壁和台阶时动作利落潇洒。试玩编辑形容：“明明只是移动动作，却每一个都像在亮相。”地图采用水墨画风格，未探索区域被迷雾覆盖，道路分支紧凑，不同路线会遭遇不同Boss。S-GAME创始人兼总监梁其伟将游戏比作金字塔：底层是RPG叙事与探索，中间是复杂的关卡设计，顶端才是高速战斗——而预告片一直展示的只是顶端。

items.title: 《影之刃零》游民采访：鼓励进攻与策略而不是一招鲜
items.summary: 前段时间，我们受邀参与了《影之刃零》的闭门试玩会，并对制作人梁其伟进行了群访。

content.v: 前段时间，我们受邀前往灵游坊参加了游戏的闭门试玩会。试玩之后，游戏的制作人梁其伟也接受了现场媒体与KOL的群访。由于这次采访存在大量游戏内的概念与术语，因此我们强烈建议老哥们先阅读同时发布的试玩报告，再回来看本篇采访。
注意：本采访内容基于现场问答整理，内容有部分调整，游戏仍在开发中，最终内容以正式发售版本为准。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261008_qq_596_1/14443.jpg
省流：
1."六十六天"模式＝"逆天者"难度＋66 天死亡次数限制。没有专属新剧情，只有 66 天用尽后的一个结局动画，也不会对白金奖杯或全成就产生影响。
2.只推主线的话大约能拿到全游戏50%－60% 的资源，已经足够把主力武器组合升满。
3.游戏并不是纯动作游戏，而是在大型 RPG 的底子上加了类似 ACT 的战斗玩法，有养成，也有数值。
4.游戏鼓励主动进攻、压制敌人，而非被动防守，Boss 约七成杀气消耗要靠玩家主动进攻和连招压制打出来。
5.目前的试玩版本中，无论是小怪还是BOSS，都对玩家的防守操作有较强的惩罚机制。偏向被动防守、弹反的玩法体验可能不是太好。因为游戏更鼓励通过针对性的策略来进行战斗，而不是一味的被动防御、弹反，但团队也会密切关注社区反馈，具体的体验适配度也会持续观察打磨。
6.一周目养成的武器可以继承到下一周目。无论是多周目还是"六十六天"模式，都不会增加新的剧情，也没有新武器，但玩家可以自由配装战斗。
7.游戏内“坐火”后并不会刷新地图怪物。虽然小怪不刷新会导致单周目获得资源有上限，但还能通过数值方面来进行调整。
8.游戏目前不考虑Boss连战的模式，但之后可能会为游戏推出更多的挑战模式。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261008_qq_596_1/20126.jpg
以下是采访原文：
Q：“六十六天”模式需要玩家以任意难度打通一周目后解锁。比较关心的是，剧情方面，“六十六天”模式是否有不同于一周目的专属新剧情？难度方面，相比其他难度模式，“六十六天”模式更难的难点在哪里？
A： “六十六天”模式其实就是“逆天者”模式的难度，加上66天死亡次数的限制。
在“逆天者”模式中，怪物的数值大概有30%-40%的部分提升，但主要还是AI的加强，玩家跟怪战斗时的博弈程度会明显增加，怪物也会有新的技能和新的连招。
“六十六天”模式基本没有任何新剧情，因为这个模式并不是大部分玩家都愿意挑战的内容。对这个模式需求最迫切的玩家可能是游戏主播，“六十六天”模式会极大提升直播的节目效果。
有天女流就跟我说，六十六天这个66就跟她很有关系，问我能不能给她一个可以一上来就能玩“六十六天”模式的存档（笑）。不过我们并不会把额外的新剧情、招式或者敌人放在这个模式里，因为其实绝大多数的玩家可能不会体验到这个模式。而且如果你想打白金或者全成就，也不用非要完成“六十六天”模式，所以这个模式是为纯粹喜欢挑战的硬核玩家，以及希望更有直播效果和表演性的主播们准备的。
不过严格来说的话，还真多了一小段剧情。就是你66天用完了，有个结局动画，也算是有点剧情，除了这个不会有额外的剧情内容了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261008_qq_596_1/20624.jpg
Q：游戏里的武器、技能和招式很多，有些偏强。比如武器【红妆鬼斩】（官方剑痴 Boss 战 PV 里"魂"用的那把）就很好用，拿到手之后后面的体验会顺不少。这类过于强力的武器和招式，后面会做平衡性调整吗？
A：游戏前几关的结构还相对线性，过程中玩家会不断拿到新武器；到中期，会有一个发散程度更高的展开。所以初期我们确实希望玩家主动去用某些特定的武器，算是一种"官方轮椅"，目的是让人体验不同种类武器的手感。
比如问题里提到的【红妆鬼斩】，用它能爽一阵，但后面还会遇到新机制，它可能就没那么好用了，需要换上之后获得的新武器。前三章都在向玩家传达武器的基本框架和一些使用技巧，所以我们想通过引导，让玩家去用特定的武器。还是拿【红妆鬼斩】说，它强的一部分原因是重型武器，带破盾机制。面对盾兵和持盾 Boss 时，你就知道可以用它破盾，不必消耗影之武装【巨凶斧】那类资源，那个槽位就能换成别的武器。
它还能在地上放出红色的花朵，怪和 Boss 站上去，杀气恢复会被限制，还会慢慢掉杀气。这个设计也在传达一个信息：杀气在游戏里非常重要。宁可血条不满，杀气也不能被打空。这也是一种软性引导。
Q：游戏探索和战斗的比重是如何分配的？一周目可获取的总资源足够升级多少把武器？因为有“坐火”后不会刷新小怪的机制，如果玩家不去探索获取额外资源的话，武器天赋的养成部分需要共用升级和强化资源，这样养成部分的压力是否过大？如何控制游戏的难度呢？
A：角色10级之前，升级材料可以无损回退；10 级之后，回退材料需要消耗特定道具【逆炼符】。如果你不做额外探索，只顺着主线剧情推进，大概能拿到全游戏 50%－60% 的资源，这已经足够把主力武器组合完全升满。如果你做一些探索的话，就可以使用多种不同的搭配。想尝试更多搭配、灵活更换武器，就要用到回退功能来重置养成材料。
Q：你之前提过游戏的 群组 AI 会更像武侠电影里的效果，不会一群人同时打你，而是一个人跟你对打、其他人在周围观察。但这次试玩里，有一些群怪的群组 AI 还是过强了，后期会怎么调？
A：路上遇到三两个零散小怪，是没有使用那种"统一大脑"群体控制的群组 AI 的，它们就是几个单独的怪凑在一起，所以有时会一起攻过来。
但如果是量很大的群怪，或者一些特定的组合，比如有三个和尚（游戏里的三铜人），他们会摆出一种阵型，会幻化金身，还有合体技。金身状态时，你需要用能破盾的武器或工具去打，然后很快就可以杀掉一到两个怪来攻克阵型。还有此前公布过的七星剑阵那种七个怪，非常典型地使用了统一大脑控制的群组 AI。不过在游戏里，三个一组的群组怪比较常见的。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261008_qq_596_1/27778.jpg
Q：一般动作游戏不太注重剧情和关卡，但《影之刃零》这两块都很吸引人。能讲讲整体设计思路吗？
A：很多玩家玩到正式版之后，会觉得游戏和之前宣传给人的印象不太一样。我们希望这对大多数人来说是一份惊喜；肯定也会有一部分玩家不适应，这都很正常。
我们之前对外放出的内容，大多展示的是战斗部分。大家看完很容易觉得这是一款主打砍杀的纯动作游戏，但真正上手就会发现，游戏底层是一套完整的大型 ARPG 框架：有大地图、任务指引、丰富支线、大量 NPC，剧情叙事密度和穿插的过场动画都远超预想。
科隆游戏展的时候，就有一些海外媒体跟我聊到这件事。他原本以为《影之刃零》是一款纯动作游戏，体验过后才意识到，这是在大型 RPG 的底子上加了类似 ACT 的战斗，其实有养成，有数值，这也是我们一次品类融合的尝试。
如果拆开来看，整个游戏可以理解成三层金字塔的结构：底座是一套传统 ARPG 系统，包含地图、支线、任务目标。但我们做了取舍，没有做过度强制引导，也没有密密麻麻的任务提示，就是为了规避罐头式的开放世界。
中间一层，关卡设计吸收了部分魂系的立体场景思路，同时保留相对清晰的路线指引，玩家不会严重迷路。
最顶上的塔尖，才是目前大家看到的炫酷战斗。但这个战斗并不是要去挑战什么深度和操作上限，而是充分展示一种此前没见过的视觉表达，操作上保持在一个适度的范围。
从开发工作量来说，底层的 RPG 部分才是最耗人力的；大家在宣传片里看到的炫酷战斗，其实只是金字塔的塔尖。底层这套内容很难用 PV 展示出来，也会成为正式发售时给玩家的惊喜。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261008_qq_596_1/34166.jpg
Q：游戏中存在不少需要拿到特定“影之武装”才能解锁的区域，同时“篝火点”支持快速传送，方便玩家回头再探索。但传送要消耗一种道具【穿行符】，这类道具在野外拿不到太多，也无法在商店购买，导致每次传送都会攒一堆任务再集中往返。这是有意设计吗？
A：游戏里会投放很多【穿行符】，但并不想让玩家随时随地无限制传送，本质上还是希望能控制一下游玩的节奏。
游戏的底层是 ARPG，同时我们也研究了市面上大量的开放世界游戏。很多作品到后期，玩家大量时间都在对着大地图操作，靠传送点来回传清任务，沉浸感会被削弱，游戏慢慢变成 to do list 式的纯 UI 化体验，地图本身也失去了探索的意义。
而魂类游戏则全程依靠玩家亲自跑图探索，可能会比较硬核。我们希望能有一种折中的处理：一方面减轻纯魂类容易迷路的压力，保留地图功能；另一方面，也想避免罐头式开放世界后期那种彻底 UI 化的体验。
我们希望玩家的大部分时间，能沉浸在游戏里实景场景的探索中。而且赶路途中，玩家还有可能偶遇新的事物，触发意料之外的内容。我们的思路是，可以传送至目标附近，再短距离步行抵达，在便利性和探索沉浸感之间找一种平衡。当然，我也不敢说这种设计肯定没问题，只是我们选择做这样一次尝试。

content.v: 9月3日，触乐应灵游坊邀请，参加了《影之刃零》的闭门线下试玩会。这次试玩的重要之处在于，活动中提供的版本可以说与即将发售的版本没有太大区别。在约5个小时的试玩过程中，我们较为完整地体验到了故事开场、剧情CG、关卡设计与Boss战，甚至还有手柄反馈这类细节，流程涵盖整个第一章的大地图、隐藏图、隐藏Boss，少量第二章内容以及两个后期Boss。
如果说，之前灵游坊零星放出的试玩还会让人有种管中窥豹的感觉，这次试玩让人对游戏的整体质量感到相当安心。在探索与战斗体验上，《影之刃零》维持着一贯的高水准；尤其是，过去游戏在关卡和养成方面展示的较少，这次也给我们带来了最大的惊喜。新遇见的Boss也各有各的特色。另外，在剧情和RPG要素上，我们也有了一些新的体会。
■ 大而丰富的地图与探索
此前，《影之刃零》对战斗系统的披露较多，这次就从新内容开始说起。尤其是此前较少介绍的关卡设计和RPG要素。
从第一章的体验来看，《影之刃零》在流程设计上更多遵循的是RPG游戏的逻辑，甚至带有一些隐性的银河城要素。关卡本身是线性的，不需要玩家去开放世界奔走，但地图的立体性很强。光是第一章的大地图，就有上中下三层结构可以探索——上层的钢铁巨塔，中层的平原与溪流，下层的支线岔路河谷，而且还有非常重要的隐藏层。
玩家在初见的时候，是不可能把这么大的章节地图探完的。游戏中的影之武装兼具副武器和探索道具的功能。锁链、斧头、弓箭等，都可以帮玩家取得在初始状态下无法取得的物品、打开过去无法通过的道路。而获得这些道具、开启隐藏通路，要么需要做支线，要么需要打败强敌，要么需要等待剧情自然推进。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-08/1216ac7b5e63fb54.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
在对第一章的探索中，这种需要逐步解锁的推进感的确给了我很多惊喜。而且游戏的Boss战和精英敌人的战斗其实比较密集，这种探索也在节奏上给予玩家喘息的机会，不至于一直处在高速战斗的紧张状态。
RPG要素则大都与NPC和支线剧情挂钩。游戏中NPC支线出乎意料地多，甚至令人想起一些JRPG的村任务。除了获取额外道具、奖励，玩家是否完成支线也会一定程度上影响每个人物的命运甚至游戏的结局。游戏相当友好地把影响重大的支线用特殊的颜色标注出来，显著区别于一般的跑腿任务。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-08/1886ac7b5e5cefb8.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
又因为地图整体来说比较线性，支线任务比较友好地分布在和主线比较顺路的方向。而且是否完成任务、在什么地方去交任务等等标注也十分明确，可以说基本杜绝了在迷路中浪费时间的可能性。而且地图的连通性很强。在第一章中，我偶然发现位于下层的支线河谷最后能够直接从侧面爬上钢铁巨塔，这的确是一个惊喜。而错综复杂的立体地图也方便放置隐藏岔路和隐藏Boss，猝不及防遭遇的时候非常有意思。
在过去的访谈中，制作人梁其伟曾表示，《影之刃零》希望结合“魂”系游戏的地图探索体验和ACT游戏的战斗体验。目前看来，在关卡设计上他们确实往这方面倾注了不少用心，而且做成了一个更加友好、注重乐趣而非“步步惊心”的版本。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-08/5466ac7b5e60302c.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
养成要素目前主要集中在主人公技能树和武器升级这两个方面。游戏的武器升级材料给得比较大方，并且根据武器特性有所区分（比如长武器、远程武器都有单独的养成资源），材料不会互相占用。地图和商店中也会准备价格相对低廉的回退材料。考虑到前期的武器掉落比较密集，玩家乐于尝试用有针对性的武器对付强敌，游戏的确给了玩家相当宽松的尝试空间。
至于主线剧情，《影之刃零》沿袭了主人公“魂”脱离隐秘江湖中的“组织”后，因为心脏遭到重创而只能存活66天、并在这仅剩的时间中揭开昔日阴谋的故事。熟悉“影之刃”这个IP的玩家会知道它不完全是一个传统武侠故事。实际上，第一章充满朋克风格的钢铁巨塔一出现，就已经明确地展现了游戏独创的幻想世界观。第二章中受到幻术影响的森林，风格更是梦幻。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-08/9716ac7b703c2a1b.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
而除了特殊的最高难度模式“66天”，其余所有难度中，天数的推进完全是剧情效果，玩家一定能在66天结束前打到结局，所以在游玩过程中不必因时间的流逝而感到慌张。
■ 高速与机制并存的战斗
哪怕《影之刃零》在过去两三年中频繁地放出Demo给玩家在线下展会体验，这次的战斗部分仍然给了我一些惊喜。
首先自然是大量的新Boss。主要关底Boss“‘组织’猎杀者：追命”，以及其中一个守门Boss“剑痴”都各具特色。尤其是“剑痴”还会掉落颇具特色的醉剑武器。
“追命”作为游戏的首个关底大Boss，继承担了一定的教学任务，也把“杀气改造”的世界观揭露一角。
在一阶段，他是一个相对常规的快攻Boss，以近战攻击为主，玩家只需要格挡然后挑选机会反击即可。一旦进入二阶段，它就成为了一个远近程皆可的棘手存在——借助锁链施展的远程刀刃伤害很高，而若玩家逼近，他又很喜欢“放风筝”一般地后跳和满场乱窜。玩家无论是使用追击流、鬼步流（完美格挡）还是影之武装流的打法，面对的都是前所未有的全新机制，到达此处时很可能会卡一阵子。
好在，游戏十分友好地给Boss“锁阶段”了——在二阶段的战斗中死亡后，玩家直接从二阶段重新挑战，不必被迫把一阶段练成“无伤”。考虑到游戏的血瓶等回复资源并不充足，这一设置确实极大地降低了重复挑战的难度。
“剑痴：花千笑”则引入了更加多样的机制。Boss满是醉态的招式本身就既新奇又有观赏性，他身上喝酒带来的Buff则要求玩家用几乎穷追猛打的方式不断打断他的动作，否则可能会感觉怎么打对方都不掉血……醉剑这把武器到玩家手中后，也是一把非常有趣的自Buff武器，并且有可以攻击到远程的“剑气”。在面对一些格外热衷于“放风筝”的Boss时，相当有用。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-08/6146ac7b5e6718af.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
本次活动特地给我们体验的两位后期Boss确实有一定难度。“双蛇夫人白赤练”是一位蛇女，虽然二阶段有NPC助战，但因为她基本不落地，只能要么使用有远程的武器，要么格外注意反制红光技和蓝光技，进行各种完美防御、完美闪避才能对她进行有效进攻。“舞狮尊主烈焰”则是一场很有表演性的Boss战。玩家不仅要和尊主及其弟子进行常规战斗，还需要在梅花桩上和对方互相扔火球……
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-08/3406ac7b6ca2df51.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
无论是之前推出过试玩的还是新增的Boss，都体现出《影之刃零》十分鼓励玩家进攻的理念。游戏中的“杀气”相当于架势条和蓝条的结合体，本来就需要通过不断进攻获得；一味格挡则会不断消耗。精纯杀气属于攒大招的资源，需要通过精防、完美闪避等精确的操作获得。
在试玩现场的群访中，制作人梁其伟也表示，虽然“无意教大家玩游戏”，但在机制和数值设计上，游戏中的强敌的确都被设置成了很难通过被动打法战胜的类型。
在这种满足了高速动作的爽快感的基础上，每个Boss多少都需要一些玩家需要用策略反制的机制。像是方才所说的，面对“醉剑”需优先考虑打断他的自Buff行为，面对“舞狮尊主”则可以考虑用水枪浇灭他的火焰并增加闪电伤害等等……可见，制作组的确考虑到了“即使玩简单难度也能获得乐趣”这件事。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-10-08/8046ac7bd482f123.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 结语
完整地体验了《影之刃零》第一章及部分后期Boss之后，我认为，仍在观望游戏整体质量的玩家可以放下心来。正式版的质量，不仅与此前若干次试玩所放出的内容持平，在关卡、地图和支线上，也没有什么有可能“拉胯”的部分。
唯一需要注意的是，即使游戏在战斗设计上非常注重保持沿袭自传统武术的功夫特色，《影之刃零》本身并不是一部遵循传统武侠风格的作品。不仅是因为世界观原本就被称为“武侠朋克”，也因为它在美学和叙事上，的确会采用一些偏向幻想和演绎的内容。“影之刃”系列的老玩家对此自然不陌生，而新玩家可能会需要重新发现与适应。

Key Preview Takeaways:

I play so many sweaty action games that pit me against insanely difficult bosses and require the most tight reaction times imaginable that it actually takes quite a lot to get me to pay attention these days. I’ll admit that when I first saw the Phantom Blade Zero gameplay trailers, I didn’t immediately get the hype. After all, this sword-wielding parry-happy action game exists in an era where we get at least a dozen of these a year. It only took about five minutes with developer S-GAME’s Phantom Blade Zero to see how it sets itself apart, though, with the most smooth and satisfying action since Sekiro, a surprising number of things to do and secrets to find while exploring each level, and a story that seems like it’ll go harder than I expected it to. After over six hours bum-rushing my way through the first leg of the adventure, I left utterly champing at the bit to play more, and have now joined the ranks of those who count this among their most anticipated games of 2026.

The thing that immediately jumped out at me about this finely honed action game is just how much it effortlessly oozes style. One cutscene has a character played by Donny Yen balancing a baby on the edge of his blade while he fights off numerous attackers, one boss encounter involved me fighting (and eventually taking on the form of) one of those awesome dancing lions you see in Chinatown on Chinese New Year – even the first few minutes have your character choosing which heart he wants to receive from a creepy ghost monster guy just to make sure you know that the game you’re playing is metal as hell. It’s honestly pretty hard to make your action game with a cool swordmaster protagonist fighting off hordes of monsters stand apart from all the others given how common this trope is at this point, and yet I don’t think there was any point in my time playing where I went more than half an hour without running into something I hadn’t seen before. It’s incredibly impressive stuff!

That’s all without getting to the combat itself, which is without question the star of the show here. I don’t think there was even one second of Phantom Blade Zero where I didn’t feel like a complete badass. Some of the many examples I encountered include: riding atop a horse-drawn wagon while fighting off armed pursuers and blocking their gunfire with your sword, killing off enemies with absolutely brutal finishers after you’ve broken their guard meter with repeated parries, and keeping two enemies at bay on either side of you by executing an absurdly cool double kick at the same time.

This game has an incredible knack for making you feel like you’re the only person in the world who could have pulled something like that off, and a lot of that is in how smooth the parry mechanics and attack combos are. I surprised myself by how often I was able to do crazy things like parry three thrown daggers in quick succession, then follow it up with a series of attacks that sent me flipping through the air and spinning gracefully as I smacked around enemies like it was nothing, even though most were no slouches themselves. I’m a bit of a snob when it comes to action games, so if the parry windows aren’t just right, or the attacks don’t feel quite satisfying in some imperceptible way, I tend to become disenchanted really quickly. But Phantom Blade Zero gets so many of those tiny details just right, making it incredibly hard to put down.
Tools of the Trade

And if the core ways in which the combat feels satisfying are what pulled me in, then the fact that I was able to experience it all over again from a new framing thanks to the bevy of melee weapons was what held my interest. I don’t know how many weapons this thing has or if all of them are as unique as what I got my hands on in this section of the adventure, but just about every weapon of destruction I tried out felt extremely bespoke. I got one massive, two-handed blade by defeating an optional secret boss that carried me to victory through a ton of encounters thanks to its ability to deal an insane amount of damage, while another boss who was a drunken fighting master awarded me with his drunken fighting style after his defeat, which allowed me to bob and weave like a champ, moving unpredictably as I guided my blade telekinetically in front of me, even able to send it flying at the enemy as a ranged weapon. The differences between these kinds of weapons were so stark that it took a ton of time to adjust to each one, learning the combos available to me alongside the pros and cons of using each one as I went, and that went an incredibly long way to help keep my attention as I sliced through the 100th minion enemy in half an hour.

There’s also a surprising amount to upgrade as you master your kung fu skills, whether it’s enhancing weapons by investing materials in them to improve their stats and capabilities, or by investing in the various paths of the skill tree, which offer everything from active abilities like one that allows you to interrupt your own attacks to execute a quick dodge out of the way, to passive perks like one that restores your Sha-Chi (used to perform certain special actions) faster than normal. For an action game that’s mostly focused on pulling off sick kills, there’s a surprising amount of RPG that’s snuck its way into the mix here, and I’m all for it. It’s nice to have breaks from combat to do some good old fashioned buildcrafting, even if it didn’t seem to go all that deep from what I saw.
Who’s the Boss?

Boss fights can make or break a game like Phantom Blade Zero, so it’s a good thing that just about every one I played was an absolute banger. While most of the early fights were pretty bog standard stuff, like a hooded man throwing chained blades at me, or a big burly monstrosity swinging an ax the size of a grown man, it wasn’t long before some more interesting and original ideas took center stage. In one fight I perfected a dance of death against a snake lady who swooped through the air in a barrage of hilariously convoluted strikes, which put my fast reaction times and ability to read enemy movements to the test. On the other hand, the duel against the lion dancers wasn’t as chaotic, since most of the attacks were slower and fairly telegraphed, but the difficulty lied in having to come up with creative ways to get around the lion mask’s nigh-impenetrable armor, which I eventually learned the trick to throwing this fiery foe off its balance that I won’t spoil here. I’d really like to give more specific examples here, except developer S-GAME has asked me to not mention some of the cool bosses I fought so as not to spoil too many of them, so you’ll just have to take my word that there’s some pretty neat stuff in there.

Speaking of boss fights, much has been made of Donnie Yen’s role in Phantom Blade Zero as the mysterious Mó Yuan, and with good reason – this guy is freaking Ip Man, after all! The dude somehow managed to be the coolest guy in a Star Wars movie for crying out loud!. While I definitely won’t go into details on the way his character weaves his way into the story or the nature of these fights, I’ll say that I was pretty surprised by how this component of the adventure takes shape. Facing this obviously formidable foe didn’t go down the way I thought it would, and running into him multiple times over the course of my playtime was definitely a highlight, and featured some of the downright coolest animations I’ve seen in an action game in a very long time.

items.title: Daredevil Star Charlie Cox Confirms He's in an Unannounced Sega Game | NYCC 2026
items.summary: Daredevil star Charlie Cox has confirmed that he is starring in another video game, this one for Sega.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/08/charlie-cox-confirms-he-stars-in-unnanounced-sega-game-1791501696523.jpg
Daredevil star Charlie Cox has confirmed that he is starring in another video game, this one for Sega.
Cox opened up about the project at New York Comic-Con 2026, telling IGN’s Jeffrey Vega that he’s completed recording for an as-yet unannounced Sega video game.
“I did another one! It doesn’t have a name yet,” he said. “I did a Sega one. I’ve done one since. It hasn’t come out yet. It was fun to do. It’s hard. It’s a whole different job, man.”
Cox went on to share a humorous anecdote about his experience working on the game, saying that the crew weren’t aware that he wasn’t American.

“I’m not sure what I’m allowed to say, but I showed up for it, and I met them for the first time, they asked me to do this game, and so I agreed to it. Then I had to do 40 hours or whatever it was, and I showed up for the first day, and I was like, ‘Hi guys, nice to meet you! How are you?’ And all of them went, ‘...oh, he’s English.’ They’d hoped, they’d wanted him to be American. But now I’ve got to do 40 hours of lines I’ve not prepared in an accent. Yeah, I think they thought I was American.”

This, at least, gives us one bit of information about his role in the mysterious game — he’ll be playing an American character (or at least, a character with an American accent), and it’s likely that his role will be central to the plot, given that he recorded 40 hours’ worth of lines for it.
It's also worth noting that Cox confirmed he was working on a new game earlier this year, though he similarly declined to mention many details at the time.

Thus far, that’s all we know. Cox has already proven his voice acting chops with Expedition 33 , where he played Gustave, famously recording all of his lines in a mere four-hour session. Players lauded his performance after the game released in 2025, and he was even nominated for Best Performance at the Game Awards that year.

Sega’s upcoming lineup of video game releases includes Stranger Than Heaven , Virtua Fighter Crossroads , Persona 6 , and Alien: Isolation 2 , among several others. Given that this particular project doesn’t even have a name yet, it’s unlikely that it’s any of these that have already been announced, so we’ll just have to wait and see what’s in store.

In the meantime, fans of Charlie Cox can look forward to Daredevil: Born Again Season 3, though this is set to be the end of Matt Murdock’s current adventures — at least for the time being. The news broke in late September alongside reports that its showrunner, Dario Scardapane, exited the series while it was in post-production.

Kingpin actor Vincent D’Onofrio penned a heartfelt goodbye to the series on social media, writing, “We have the final Season, season 3 heading your way next year with some very cool stuff. Much love to all who have been supportive. I love that character Fisk. Always will. Off to another neck off the woods. Meanwhile… Season 3 is coming!”
Daredevil Born Again: Season 3 is set to release in early 2027.

Nitrate Games revealed the first footage and new details about its upcoming farm sim video game Jay and Silent Bob’s Joint Venture at New York Comic Con on Thursday. IGN can exclusively share the first trailer for the game, which you can watch via the player embedded below.

Jay and Silent Bob’s Joint Venture promises a funny and raunchy spin on the cozy farming genre, with creator Kevin Smith’s iconic characters out to “build the best weed farm in town.” Players will build, cultivate and expand their operation, interact with familiar faces, and experience an original story written by Ernie Altbacker (the animated films Batman: Hush and Justice League Dark).
Kevin Smith and Jason Mewes have been creative forces on the project from the start.

“Since Jay and Silent Bob are the stars of this hilarious growing game, I cannot wait to play with myself!,” said Kevin Smith in a statement provided to IGN. “Many thanks to Nitrate Games for taking my little animals to this crossing and making them Stars Dew a Valley!”

“Joint Venture is a Jay and Silent Bob game, but it’s actually a continuation of Kevin Smith’s View Askewniverse,” says Nitrate Games co-founder Montana Sommese. “The central narrative picks up where the films left off, making the game a kind of sequel. Players can befriend and engage with their favorite characters from Kevin Smith's movies like never before. As we update the game over time, we're excited to be able to expand Kevin's story universe with narrative updates that will continue building from his cinematic universe.”

The NYCC panel revealed that other familiar faces from the View Askewniverse appear in the game, including Clerks’ Dante, Randal and Veronica; Mallrats’ Brodie and T.S. Quint; Chasing Amy’s Holden, Banky, Hooper and Alyssa; Dogma’s Azrael and Serendipity; Clerks II’s Becky & Elias; and Mooby.

Jay and Silent Bob’s Joint Venture is currently heading toward its play testing phase of production, with an expected release in late Spring 2027 on Steam/PC. A console release is also slated for 2027. Fans can learn more and s ign up to playtest and wishlist.

Smile 2 star Kyle Gallner is making it known that he’s ready and willing to play V in Paramount’s live-action film adaptation of Cyberpunk 2077.

Cyberpunk 2077 has come a long way from its roots as a tabletop RPG. Thanks to CD Projekt Red’s video game and its standout expansion, as well as the critically-acclaimed Edgerunners spinoff anime from Studio Trigger, fans of the gritty sci-fi series are eating well.

They’re about to get fed even more, as Paramount revealed that it is developing a live-action movie based on the franchise. Thus far, we’re not sure of any plot details, so it’s possible that we could follow V’s adventures with Johnny Silverhand, or Idris Elba’s Solomon Reed before he meets V — or heck, maybe even Edgerunner 2’s Weak Kingsley, for all we know!

What we do know is that there’s no shortage of possibilities for this film, and that’s what has fans so excited. One of these fans is none other than actor Kyle Gallner, who is raring to step into Night City as the male version of V.

Mere hours after Paramount announced the news on October 8, Gallner posted a photo of himself sporting a close-shaved crop of hair, similar to V’s hairstyle in the game’s marketing materials, along with the caption: “Take me to night city.”
It’s safe to say that fans are pretty enthusiastic about this possible casting, with many already envisioning Gallner alongside Keanu Reeves’ Johnny Silverhand.
Take me to night city. https://t.co/qchq61ZW9P

items.title: Street Fighter 6 Producer Reveals How He Helped Save Capcom’s Iconic Fighting Game Franchise From ‘Dying’
items.summary: Street Fighter 6 producer Shuhei Matsumoto revealed how dire things were for Capcom’s flagship fighting game f

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/08/04/sf6-outfits-blog-1754304622675.jpg

Street Fighter 6 producer Shuhei Matsumoto revealed how dire things were for Capcom’s flagship fighting game franchise during the Street Fighter V era and explained how he and director Takayuki Nakayama worked together to save the series from death.

It’s no secret that Street Fighter V stumbled massively when it launched in February 2016. Many players felt that it was shipped out in an unfinished state, as it lacked basic elements like an arcade mode or story mode, on top of its incredibly unstable netplay.

Shuhei Matsumoto — who stepped in as producer for Street Fighter V near the end of its lifetime following Yoshinori Ono’s exit from Capcom in 2020 — alongside director Takayuki Nakayama, recognized that the franchise as a whole was in peril, and believed that the Street Fighter IP might actually fade into obscurity within the next decade if they didn’t act fast.

"When the two of us were talking during Street Fighter V, we realized that if we didn't do something about Street Fighter, the Street Fighter IP would probably die in 10 years. It was critical. So, we had to make it a game where people would get to know it all over again and play it again,” Matsumoto said during an October 2026 interview with Karin Ohira .
Matsumoto explained that SFV’s aging playerbase was one example of this issue, saying Capcom needed to target younger players if it wanted Street Fighter to live.

"At that time, the player base for Street Fighter V was roughly 35 to 45 years old. In 10 years, these people will be 60. It’s difficult to sustain the franchise if we only rely on that group,” he continued.

"...It had become a distant presence. People knew of the scene, but weren't actually playing the game, which made us think, 'This is bad.' In the end, we're a game company, yet people weren't playing our game. Isn't that the most fatal thing? So that was the biggest danger. We didn't know if those people would continue with the same level of passion, and naturally, there's a lifespan to things, right? That's when we talked about how, if we left it as it was, the IP would likely die in 10 years."

So, how did they manage to turn things around so dramatically with Street Fighter 6 ? Matsumoto said that the team avoided relying on its power as a historic IP, and decided to start with a blank slate, as if no one in the current generation knew about it, at all.

"While people say Street Fighter has high name recognition, we shouldn't be overconfident. We decided to act as if the current generation doesn't know us. We have to properly explain things to those who are just starting to play games now — like who these characters are and how to play — so we don't take that familiarity for granted."

Matsumoto also said that the development of SF6's Modern control scheme was integral to reaching a new audience, alongside other approachable features like World Tour Mode (which has since been paused for the forseeable future), the Battle Hub, and real-time commentary from community figures like Vicious and Tasty Steve.

Matsumoto and Nakayama’s plan paid off big time; Street Fighter 6 is one of Capcom’s most successful Street Fighter games of all time, having sold more than seven million lifetime units as of summer 2026. It’s extremely popular both in Japan and abroad, and boasts a massive playerbase across both Steam and consoles.

It’s a big year for Street Fighter fans and Capcom in general; the developer has released three critically-acclaimed titles in Resident Evil Requiem , Pragmata , and Onimusha: Way of the Sword , and is gearing up for the Street Fighter movie on October 16, which comes on the heels of the Resident Evil adaptation directed by horror savant Zach Cregger.

items.title: Ben Affleck Says He Gets Into Arguments With Kids in Fortnite, His New Movie Took Inspiration from Game's Skins
items.summary: Ben Affleck has revealed he plays shooters like Fortnite and sometimes ends up getting into arguments with kid

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/08/ben-affleck-1791496638367.jpg
Ben Affleck has revealed he plays shooters like Fortnite and sometimes ends up getting into arguments with kids in voice chat.

When speaking on the New Heights podcast , Affleck was asked about the inspiration for some of the costumes in his latest film, Animals. The new Netflix thriller features a character wearing a fuzzy bunny mask, and Affleck stated that he took inspiration from Fortnite for that particular costume. He noted that his son was taking an interest in Fortnite skins and kept calling them "tough." Affleck joked that he didn't quite understand what was "tough" about a character wearing a bunny mask, but utilized it as an inspiration.
"I thought these costumes are so kind of random and unusual, that's what I based the costumes on," said Affleck. "I thought he'd be getting them off games."

The actor also noted that he plays quite a few games himself, including sports titles like Madden and 2K, as well as shooters. Affleck joked that because of his gaming experience, he believes he's good at shooters, but realizes he's not as capable as younger players.

"I always play games," he said. "I play first person shooter games, so I think I'm good, and then 12-year-olds just f**k you up. I try to come out and I'm like, ‘Here I come.’ I get killed right away, and then they taunt you, like, ‘You suck. F**k you!’ I end up getting in arguments. ‘F**k you! I don't suck! I'm a grown man!’”

Affleck has been vocal about his love for gaming before, particularly Valorant. The actor has attended multiple Valorant events with his son, noting in the past that he mains KAY/0 in the game. He also joined the Valorant e-Sports team Sentinels for a watch party last year , where he talked about his experience with the game on stream.

在探索世界的过程中，玩家可以化身为凤凰、蝎尾狮、海妖等神话生物，翻越群山，横渡海洋，翱翔天际，一个人或者和好友们一起探索这片历经战火、精心构筑的奇幻世界。
https://image.gcores.com/a67b89d7798a1cdf771aa70d61fda400-2560-1440.jpeg
不断提升神格的同时，玩家可以招募各具特色的追随者，无论神明还是凡人，皆能收入麾下。建造宏伟神庙、锻造强力装备，迎战威胁诸界的巨型怪物，逐步成就自己的神话。
https://image.gcores.com/2f50aba38420ea75f441cf9004856b2a-2560-1440.jpeg

当众神失去神力的源泉、所依存的世界随之崩塌时，会发生什么？这是我们迄今为止最具野心的作品。我们期待与大家分享这个不断拓展的神话宇宙，以及其中各个世界的更多故事。”
游戏首曝预告片的原创动画由 Powerhouse Animation Studios 制作，该工作室曾打造《宙斯之血》《恶魔城》等广受好评的动画剧集。预告片配乐则由布达佩斯配乐乐团现场录制，演奏阵容超过 60 人。

items.title: Why a 21-year-old coder finally ported the real P.T. to PC: 'That something so influential could eventually become unplayable never sat right with me'
items.summary: Not emulation or a remake, a native PC port of Kojima's horror classic has arrived.

content.v: One of the most beloved horror games (demos?) of all time is finally free from the shackles of the PS4. Hideo Kojima's P.T. has been natively ported to PC by programmer Lorean Xavier, who made the project public this week. Not an emulator nor a remake, the native PC client does not contain any copyrighted materials—it requires a dumped copy of P.T. to function—but instead translates the original code into something that'll run on Windows and Linux.

That distinction not only sidesteps potential corporate scrutiny, but also allows Xavier to add modern graphical features and mod support to the PC version. It's an impressive effort that, according to the creator, has been in the works since 2024.

"I wanted to make the version of P.T. that my younger self always wished existed," Xavier, 21, told PC Gamer over email. "My attachment to the game goes all the way back to my childhood. I remember watching videos of it on my phone, wishing I could experience it myself. I didn't have a PS4, so playing the original was never really an option for me. I never imagined back then that I'd eventually be the one bringing it to PC."

The window to play P.T. "legitimately" was famously brief. Kojima surprise-dropped P.T. on the PlayStation Network in 2014 as a "playable teaser" for the Silent Hills reboot he was making with Guillermo Del Toro. When Kojima and Konami had a falling out, Silent Hills was canceled and P.T. got caught in the breakup, being delisted in early 2015. The horror classic has persisted only through emulation and preserved PS4 hard drives—until now.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/k4yRntF5mZN8zXCcRWucBj-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/RPubjfA5Zo5vp4ZpXyQ9aj-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/weJsnK6JUUc4GmJdU4AqDi-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/EukeTD8C8yW9ZmkjZf6Xhi-1920-80.jpg
I think there's an important distinction between using AI as a development tool and blindly relying on it to create an entire project you don't understand.
Lorean Xavier, PT-PC developer
"The idea that something so influential could eventually become practically unplayable never sat right with me," Xavier added.

"There have been several PC remakes over the years, and I appreciate that people tried to preserve the experience, but none of them ever really satisfied me," Xavier said. "Something always felt off, whether it was the lighting, the atmosphere, the interactions, or the way certain events played out. They could resemble P.T. visually, but they never truly felt like the original to me.

"And that's exactly why I wanted to do this differently. I didn't want to make another interpretation of P.T. or recreate it approximately in another engine. I wanted the actual experience, with its original assets, sounds, animations, and behavior, running natively on PC."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/BGPbBNoqiTJTQBfQfatozh-1920-80.jpg
While the project is "not a modified version or fork of [PS4 emulator] shadPS4," the emulated version was an "extremely valuable" reference to compare the original game's behavior to the port.

We're in weird and wild times for the recompilation scene as gen AI has accelerated the creation of console-to-PC ports, often with janky, hastily-vibecoded results that make good preservation more difficult. Xavier is open about using AI in his workflow, but believes it's no replacement for "actually knowing what you're doing."

"I think there's an important distinction between using AI as a development tool and blindly relying on it to create an entire project you don't understand. In my case, I use AI to help with debugging, identifying issues, testing code, and working through problems when I get stuck. It can be incredibly useful for accelerating that process, especially when you're working alone on something this complicated.

"But I'm still the one responsible for the architecture, the implementation decisions, writing and reviewing the code, and understanding how the different systems fit together. My years of experience with reverse engineering and P.T. are what allow me to direct that process in the first place."

This is incredible. Unlike the previous decade of fan "recreations" of P.T. for PC which always seemed to miss important but minor details, this is (as far as I can tell?) a 1:1 port of the entire codebase. It creates all of the undocumented behavior I know of perfectly. October 7, 2026

In terms of faithfulness, the port has the seal of approval from at least one person who would know: Lance McDonald , the Australian creator who datamined P.T. and discovered many of its secrets back in the day, is impressed by what he reckons is a "1:1 port of the entire codebase."
You can check out the "PT-PC" project for yourself on GitHub.

content.v: 近日外媒IGN放出对R星North联席负责人罗布・尼尔森(Rob Nelson)采访，披露大量《GTA6》尚未公开的玩法细节。本作可能会加入更露骨的成人内容，包括性爱场景等。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261009/1791494050_791279_jpg_r.jpg
杰森与露西亚的浪漫亲密内容完全可选，不会强制玩家体验，也不提供战斗、收益类游戏加成，但会改变部分剧情演出走向。提升关系的方式不只有主线任务：双人可以打台球、迷你高尔夫、潜水、海滩漫步;一同抢劫作案同样能够增进感情。
角色之间会互相发送短信，长期无视消息会轻微降低好感;关系良好时可以触发牵手等互动。即便恋爱关系冷淡，二人依旧是犯罪搭档，主线剧情依旧可以正常推进。未操控的角色拥有独立日常行为逻辑，切换角色时，你可能撞见杰森正在洗澡等生活化场景。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261009/1791494050_435296.jpg
尼尔森称R星团队认真打磨了双人的亲密戏份，力求表演自然真实，同时吸取历史教训，避开类似“热咖啡事件”的争议内容，不会做猎奇式的小游戏设计。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261009/1791494050_891877.jpg

尼尔森表示：“我们不希望自己在这方面表现得如此糟糕。这些角色在一起的感觉非常自然——真的非常自然。对于任何想要尝试以角色扮演的方式体验他们之间关系的人来说，这都非常棒。团队中的很多人都已与这些角色产生共鸣。但身体上的亲密行为是恋爱关系中非常重要的一部分，所以必须把它做好。就像我们做的任何事情一样，我们必须不断尝试各种方案，然后继续迭代，直到我们找到感觉正确的方式。我们绝对希望朝着正确的方向去做。”

content.v: 近日《星之卡比》《任天堂明星大乱斗》创作者樱井政博宣布，自己主持长达16年的“游戏设计师奖”将停办，主要原因是没能找到合适的后继者接手奖项工作。在颁奖致辞中，他聊到了原创、市场销量与玩家消费心理之间非常现实的行业矛盾。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261009/1791493375_979461_jpg_r.jpg
樱井政博直言：“说一句比较残酷的实话，原创性其实对游戏销量的影响并不大，在商业层面它的优先级并不高”。他拿便利店饮料做类比，消费者大多倾向选择自己熟悉、口味已经被验证的产品，很少主动去尝试全新的陌生口味。放到游戏市场也是同理，玩家更愿意为自己熟悉的IP、熟悉的玩法掏钱，以此规避踩雷的风险，大家更想要得到符合自身期待的体验。
但即便原创很难转化成商业销量，樱井政博依旧强调原创对于行业的不可替代性，一个彻底丢掉原创能力的游戏产业，只会一步步走向缓慢死亡。如今我们玩到的所有成熟玩法、热门类型，全部都来自过去敢于冒险尝试新东西的创作者，如果不再有人去开拓全新的娱乐形式，行业便会失去向前发展的根基。
虽然游戏设计师奖就此落幕，樱井政博依旧呼吁整个业界与玩家继续关注那些具备新奇创意、拥有独特特质的作品，不要只盯着商业表现。他的发言也在游戏社区引发讨论，不少玩家认同当下3A大作越来越保守，续作、重启项目占据主流，但也有玩家表示商业生存是工作室活下去的前提，如何平衡原创创新与市场收益，一直是摆在开发者面前的难题。

Dragon's Dogma 2 's Dark Arisen expansion introduces the new northern, wintery region of Norgan, long abandoned by civilised folk, the realm is home to many monsters and mysteries.

To start Dark Arisen, you'll have to speak to Captain Brant in The Stardrop Inn in Vernworth at nighttime. Vernworth is accessible relatively early via the main story. When speaking to him you'll see two new dialogue options:
The recommended level for the DLC content and Norgan is 40, though it can be accessed earlier, and the dungeons each vary in difficulty.

items.title: Resident Evil Requiem Was Originally Planned as an Online Game, Producer Says
items.summary: Resident Evil Requiem producer Masachika Kawata revealed that the game was originally planned to be an online

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/03/03/puzzle-site-1772543174828.png
Resident Evil Requiem producer Masachika Kawata revealed that the game was originally planned to be an online title before they scrapped the idea to focus on horror.

Kawata shared this information in the BIOHAZARD 30th Special Mook (‘magazine book’), a 124-page, full-color fan book with a complete history of the series' timeline, creature genealogy, and developer interviews.

“Every game is a continuous process of trial and error. For example, with Resident Evil Requiem, [game director Koshi Nakanishi] initially went so far as to develop it as an online game,” he said, via a fan translation.
“However, the results of research conducted partway through development were not favorable, so we decided to prioritize the horror concept once again and abandoned the online direction.”

That’s not the only wild thing Kawata revealed in the mook; he also said that Leon was the first character the team chose as a protagonist, but they ultimately felt that being able to hack and slash zombies with ease would lean too heavily on the ‘action’ side of things, making the overall game less scary.

“Leon was also the first character confirmed to appear as a protagonist. However, we determined that with Leon alone, who excels in combat, ‘horror would no longer work,’ so it was decided to introduce Grace as a new character,” he continued.

Kawata also explained why Capcom decided to wait before sharing Leon’s involvement in the game, saying, “by keeping the full picture of the game, which would develop along both the horror and action sides, until the very end, we were able to successfully maintain interest in it up until release.”

Nakanishi’s early plans to make RE9 an online game isn’t something totally surprising, given that management at Capcom had also pushed for Resident Evil 7 to have multiplayer and microtransactions during its conceptual phase.

"Right around that time, there was a big push at Capcom, a big 'marketing' push, saying 'we have to make the games players are asking for,'" franchise producer Jun Takeuchi said in 2022. "So we were being told 'make this, make that', it was really hard on the directors at the time. 'Online multiplayer' this, 'downloadable content' that. 'Ongoing service games! Microtransactions! Make a Resident Evil game that ticks all those boxes!'

“The idea of multiplayer got killed off pretty quickly. If we could properly put it together, we could make an exciting horror multiplayer game, but we didn’t really have any good ideas, so we set it aside. We went down the list, chopping them out, until we had marketing’s worst nightmare — a regular old single-player horror game."

Capcom is moving full speed ahead with many of its high-profile IPs, Resident Evil being one of them. The series just enjoyed a film adaptation directed by Zach Cregger, and a Code Veronica remake is set to release in February next year. Given that the devs of RE9 didn’t move forward with an online version of the game, it’s possible that we see another online Resident Evil title in the future — perhaps another Resident Evil Outbreak?

items.title: US government accuses Microsoft of replacing American workers with 'foreign indentured servants,' then gives Satya Nadella a medal
items.summary: The suspension of Microsoft's access to green card applications represents just another wildly incoherent day

content.v: Just three months after Microsoft shot down a racist conspiracy theory claiming the company was laying off thousands of American workers so it could replace them with foreigners via the H-1B visa program, the Trump administration has suspended the company's ability to apply for green cards for workers on the H-1B program, accusing it of fraudulently using the program to replace American workers with foreigners.
There has been no company in the United States, unfortunately, that has abused this system more than Microsoft
JD Vance, vice president of the United States of America

"The H-1B visa program is meant to allow companies to bring in the best of the best from outside the United States of America for positions that are completely impossible to fill with American workers," US vice president JD Vance said (via AP ). "Unfortunately, the program has become rife with fraud over the last several years—probably the last several decades.

"There has been no company in the United States, unfortunately, that has abused this system more than Microsoft ... Microsoft laid off last year 6,000 American workers. At the same time, the company benefitted from 6,300 H-1B visas and almost 3,000 green cards. In other words, if you do the math, for every worker that Microsoft laid off, they replaced that worker with one-and-a-half foreign indentured servants."

Calling H-1B visa holders "indentured servants" is certainly a choice, painting legal immigration as a form of human trafficking and the workers as victims, rather than specialists who've chosen to work in the United States.

Microsoft will still be able to hire non-American workers on a temporary basis via the H-1B program. It simply won't be able to apply to make them permanent, and thus grant them permanent residency, via the green card program—something that clearly does not comport with the Trump administration's intense focus on mass deportations .

"Our message to Microsoft and to any other foreign or domestic corporation is quite simple," Vance said. "We obviously want you to thrive in the United States of America. We want people to invest in the United States of America, but we want you to employ American workers.

"And so our message to Microsoft is you're a great American company, but you've got to hire great American workers. You cannot lay off American workers and then replace them with foreign indentured servants."

Responding to Vance's message, Microsoft issued a statement saying it looks forward to "providing the administration with additional information," including that 80% of the roughly 6,000 H-1B applications it filed in the previous fiscal year "were to extend or change the status of existing Microsoft employees," not to hire new employees. The remaining 20%, Microsoft said, were for new employees who were already in the country legally, rather than new arrivals.

Microsoft also addressed Vance's "indentured servants" comment directly, as well as claims that H-1B workers in general are paid significantly less than their American counterparts, saying it pays employees on H-1B visas "the same as any other employees doing comparable work."

Ironically, the suspension of Microsoft's ability to apply for permanent residency for H-1B visa holders comes on the same day that US president Donald Trump presented Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella with the National Medal of Technology and Innovation. Other recipients honored today include X owner Elon Musk, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, and Dell Technologies chief Michael Dell, all of whom have been friendly with the Trump administration.

Trump recently disclosed significant Nvidia stock trades made in August, according to a new Reuters report. In September, the president renamed artificial intelligence to "Super Intelligence" and allowed the AI industry in the US to self-regulate .

items.title: Jason may or may not appear fully nude in GTA 6, but either way we've now seen his dong
items.summary: Cyberleek's back, this time with nude Jason riding a dirt bike.

others.title: No, I Have Not Seen Jason’s Penis in GTA 6

content.v: Cyberleek , the anonymous someone who's been sharing clips apparently taken from a Grand Theft Auto 6 development build, has returned after a hiatus with a new, 25-minute-long video that's circulating in places like the r/GamingLeaksAndRumours subreddit and social media.

The most notable thing about the clip—or most noticeable , at least—is that protagonist Jason spends much of it naked. His genitals are fully modelled, physics and all, which isn't too surprising given we previously saw fully nude NPCs in another of Cyberleek's GTA 6 clips.

It remains unknown whether players will be able to walk around in the buff in the retail game, as Cyberleek presumably has access to developer tools. A floating tank seen partway through the clip makes it apparent that at least some console command shenanigans are at play. It's also notable that NPCs do not react to Jason's nakedness, and that the video shows first-person driving, a feature GTA 6 was previously reported not to include.

IGN did see a naked Jason during a cutscene in an official preview of GTA 6, but "thanks to some carefully positioned camera angles, his modesty remained entirely intact." So we just don't know, although it wouldn't be the first time a GTA game included full frontal male nudity of a prominent character, which occurred in GTA 4's The Lost and Damned DLC.

GTA 6 co-protagonist Lucia also appears topless in the Cyberleek clip, facing away from the camera and wearing a thong. Whether the underwear was the leaker's choice, or if GTA 6 unevenly enforces modesty, is also unknown.
A new era of videogame dong?

Whatever level of nudity GTA 6 ultimately does or doesn't allow—and once it's on PC, you can be sure that modders will make sure nothing is disallowed—it's a bit surreal to see how not-a-big-deal it all is after once experiencing Fox News hosts being scandalized by alien boobies in Mass Effect.

I want to say that things sure have changed since GTA's infamous Hot Coffee 'sex minigame' incident , but have they ? We're certainly far from a golden age of people being chill about things; you can't throw a stone on the internet without hitting some new sect shouting about its brand of traditional values (and the dietary supplements that complement it).

And yet it didn't seem like an especially big deal to conservative critics when Baldur's Gate 3 casually gave its characters detailed nude bodies and underwear lore. If it was, I didn't see it—perhaps it's just harder to stand out in today's noise bath of discourse.
Probably more relevant is that games just got more mainstream and have an older audience on average, and so they now have an easier time getting away with all the things Hollywood does.

As Andy observed recently after reaching out to infamous GTA critic Jack Thompson: "...Grand Theft Auto won. Netflix airs its special, the NBA wears its uniform, Walmart sells it, middle-aged cops and politicos buy it, and the state of Florida wraps itself in it."

Oh, and about Cyberleek: They're back to claiming they've got a "project" underway that you should help fund. I don't recommend that. Take-Two and Rockstar continue to look for the culprit, but we haven't heard any new developments on that recently.

items.title: Vampire games on Steam are a recession indicator and I have the charts to prove it
items.summary: Nothing is scarier during Halloween season than amateur statistics.

content.v: Despite what the GDP tells me, the economy in the real world doesn't feel like it's doing too hot for the average joe. But during the recent years' descent into compounding supply crises and mass layoffs affecting thousands of workers at once, I've noticed another trend: Sure does seem like there are a lot of vampire games in the mix lately.

I started to sense an uptick after Arkane's ill-fated Redfall in 2023. There was Vampire Survivors and V Rising—and Nighthawks, Moonlight Peaks, Blood of Dawnwalker, and more. Given current circumstances, you might think I'm just primed to notice nightmarish aristocrats bleeding us alive to sustain themselves. But after too many hours of spreadsheet data entry, I'm convinced devs really have been dabbling more heavily in Draculas as the economy feels increasingly dire. Vampire games on Steam are a recession indicator. And I have the charts to prove it.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FFY9R7fKJAew58Lp52P7y6-1920-80.jpg
Datawalker

At first glance, assessing whether Steam's vampire offerings can serve as a bellwether for economic sentiment could seem like a simple task. Steam has a Vampires tag, after all. The release dates are right there. Easy, right?
Wrong.

The Vampires tag is—perhaps fittingly—a horror. Devs and users freely slapping the label on anything with even one Dracula would be bad enough, but the advent of Vampire Survivors created a categorization disaster. Before Steam added a discrete bullet heaven genre, its countless imitators were content to use the Vampires tag as a makeshift discoverability solution. It's a mess in there.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/CAvotnnQeZHhc2Pcwt5enA-1920-80.jpg

Not only that, but I wanted a more complete picture of Steam vampire activity than release dates alone can provide. When games on Steam might have taken anywhere from seven months to seven years to develop, it would've been fruitful to know when games were first listed to gauge the level of collective vampire interest among Steam devs.

Steam itself doesn't provide that info. SteamDB, however, tracks whenever a game first appeared during its scraping of Valve's store data. That's a good substitute for listing time—but unlike Steam proper, SteamDB doesn't have a public API for pulling that information.

End result: I individually sorted through the 1,213 Steam games with the Vampires tag at time of writing, manually collecting their release dates and first appearance in the SteamDB archive after determining whether they were, in fact, vampire-ass vampire games.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xB4qgQqpxLcq6tjTbNwWrT-1920-80.jpg
My process for parsing that last bit was pretty straightforward. A vampire game is a game whose developer sat down with an obvious interest in making a game about vampire stuff:

I'll admit there's an amount of subjectivity involved in my methodology, and it likely wasn't flawless—I only just realized that Resident Evil Village didn't appear in the Vampires pool, despite its big vampire lady being responsible for ongoing sexual awakenings for at least a third of the internet. But, if anything, my figures provide a conservative estimate: I excluded games that just didn't have that vampire stink on them despite literally starring Dracula as the protagonist.
Tragically, this means Hotel Transylvania 3: Monsters Overboard didn't make the cut. Apologies to Adam Sandler.
Unholy ascension

The results of my very professional data collection are clear: For years, the number of vampire games released on Steam has been increasing. In 2016, only four vampire games launched on the platform. A decade later, 65 vampire games have been released on Steam so far in 2026—and more have scheduled launch dates before the year's end.

There's been a sharp increase in the last six years. In 2020, the highest number of vampire games that launched in a single quarter was six; in 2026, it was 24. Developers are listing more vampire projects on Steam, too. Nine first appeared in SteamDB's archive in 2016; last year, 99 entered the database.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/W3qYUgXUU8JGWMNbSXhzxa-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/LPEKeyk7aj2or4DDmAKv8h-1920-80.jpg

It should be noted, of course, that the number of Steam releases in general has massively increased over the same period, from 9,634 game launches in 2020 to 21,263 in 2025. But it's not just the number of vampire games that's increased; it's the percentage.

The figure swings dramatically, but particularly over the last six years the percentage of vampire game launches has been trending steadily upwards, barring one particularly severe drop in mid-2025. The rate is still low—less than 1 in 100 games on Steam is a proper vampire game—but in some recent quarters, the percentage of vampire games was more than double what it was at the start of the decade.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/pdgCJKRNaQ5nNJ7nXg6JmF-1920-80.jpg

I'd have liked to calculate similar percentages for how many vampire game listings have been popping up over the same period—but that would require manually recording the first SteamDB appearance dates for over 100,000 games. My bosses are already annoyed at the amount of time I've spent in spreadsheets this week.

Instead, I've calculated what I call the Vampire Menace Rating™ , which divides the number of quarterly vampire game appearances on SteamDB by the quarterly total of game launches on Steam to provide a more relative image of how vampires are occupying the total mindshare. While the resulting chart's trend line has a slight climb, I wasn't sure what to make of it at first glance… until I compared it to Dracula's Castle from Castlevania . The implications, I think you'll agree, are chilling:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/rky8Q4ySEKKsVZxi34cLeU-1920-80.jpg
Okay, fine. The VMR™ might need some work. The increasing number and percentage of vampire games, however, is very real.
Blood forensics

Alright, so the number and percentage of vampire games on Steam has been trending upwards over the last six years. But can we really call that a recession indicator when we're still regularly hearing that the US stock market is breaking records and GDP is still embiggening? Sure, I might have a worsening sense of existential dread, but isn't everything good if the number is still going up?

If you happen to be—for example—one of those benefitting from the circular investments of infinite money into the emerging AI apparatus, you're probably delighted by the macroeconomic trends. But over those same six years, an accompanying set of signals indicate that, just as Nosferatus have skulked onto Steam, the average person in the US hasn't been thriving.

US Census Bureau data shows median household income rose between 2020 and 2025, even when adjusted for inflation—but only by about 4.6%. Costs, however, have risen faster. From the start of 2020 to now, the Consumer Price Index for all urban consumers—representing the costs of goods and services for roughly 88% of the US population—has increased by 27-29%, depending on whether you include the more volatile prices of food and energy.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/gV6uGn2FCqoPncuVBAfqzh-1920-80.jpg

Likewise, the Producer Price Index for wholesale trade industries has climbed over the same timespan, meaning retailers are paying more for the goods they stock their shelves with—a cost increase that's passed onto the consumer.

Unsurprisingly, there are indicators that the average American is struggling with those increased costs. After an initial dip at the start of the decade, the delinquency rate on credit card loans across all US banks has been trending upwards, signalling that American borrowers have been less capable of keeping up with payments.

content.v: Have you ever wondered what two-time Oscar-winner Ben Affleck thinks about Fortnite skins, and the game generally? You can now rest easy, as the man himself has weighed in with some strong takes.

Appearing on the New Heights podcast with brothers Jason and Travis Kelce, Affleck said he's a big gamer, and is particularly fond of first-person shooter games, so when he tried Fortnite, he thought he'd hold his own. That wasn't the case, though. He said not only did he get wiped out immediately, but the 12-year-olds he was playing against made fun of him after taking him out.

Affleck also told a brief story about how his son wanted Fortnite skins for Christmas, and he was shocked to learn the specific skins his son wanted cost hundreds of dollars. "They ain't even real? Just to wear in the game? That's bullsh**," Affleck said.
Affleck is a big fan of the competitive shooter Valorant . In the movie Gone Girl, Affleck's character can be seen playing Battlefield 3 .

items.title: Ubisoft Shutting Down Rainbow Six Mobile After Less Than A Year
items.summary: Ubisoft has announced that Rainbow Six Mobile is shutting down, and it didn't have a very long life. The game

content.v: Ubisoft has announced that Rainbow Six Mobile is shutting down, and it didn't have a very long life. The game soft-launched in 2023, but properly rolled out for everyone back in February 2026. It will shut down on January 16, 2027, so it will have been online for less than a year in its full state for everyone.

"'We are proud of the passion, creativity, and dedication our team has put into the game," Ubisoft said. "One of the greatest parts of this adventure has been getting to experience it alongside you. We've loved seeing the memes, videos, strategies, tournaments, impossible plays, and all the countless moments that happened because you were here."

The developers are going to move on to "other long-term strategic projects," but Ubisoft did not say what these may be. The studio will share more details on the game's final days in the coming weeks.
"We are truly grateful to everyone who has played our game," the developers said.

Rainbow Six Mobile pitched itself as a mobile version of the extremely popular Rainbow Six Siege, which continues to crush it more than a decade after release. The next Rainbow Six game is Rainbow Six Tactics, and it's coming next year.

It's been a bumpy year for Ubisoft, as the company created a new organizational structure by way of its partnership with Tencent. As part of this, Ubisoft enacted mass layoffs, closed studios, and cancelled games .

本次发布会值得关注的消息包括：经典冒险游戏正统续作《机械迷城2》正式公布、经典越狱系列续作《逃脱者3》全球首发、《塔罗斯法则3》首次公开实机演示、《要塞4》定档12月7日并开放全新试玩版、《雨中冒险2》第四款DLC《万象归衡》现已上线、《潜水员戴夫》宣布与《深海迷航2》推出联动DLC，以及《Among Us》原班人马新作《Among Us Story: On Guard》定档2027年2月17日等。汇总如下：
《Among Us》原班人马新作《Among Us Story: On Guard》将于2027年2月17日发售
《Among Us Story: On Guard》将于2027年2月17日正式发售！这是由《Among Us》原班人马打造的全新独立侦探叙事游戏。在伪装者对其他船员，甚至对你本人下手之前，找出真相、洗清嫌疑，证明自己的清白。谁值得相信，又是谁在暗中撒谎？
《星界战士》×《光与影：33号远征队》联动免费更新现已上线
《星界战士》×《光与影：33号远征队》联动免费更新现已上线！6个全新召唤物、3位全新头目、2首全新曲目与3种全新房间加入游戏，在快节奏战斗中与熟悉的角色和敌人再次相遇。
《土豆兄弟：史前惧兽》将于11月2日登陆PC
《土豆兄弟：史前惧兽》将于11月2日登陆Steam、Epic与GOG！全新土豆角色、武器与道具加入战斗，这一次，你将深入史前丛林，与体型更加庞大的恐龙正面交锋，证明谁才是真正的顶级掠食者！
《呼吸边缘》开发团队新作《Canyons》将于2027年11月上线
《呼吸边缘》开发团队新作《Canyons》将于2027年11月登陆Steam、PS5与Xbox Series X|S！在这款支持1至4人合作的PVE射击游戏中，与超自然生物缔结血契，驾驶履带基地车探索危险峡谷，并建造避难所，设法让船员活下去。
《Chained Together 链在一起》将于11月12日首次上线全新官方地图
多人合作游戏《Chained Together 链在一起》将于11月12日首次上线全新的官方地图！从预告剪影中能看到书桌、椅子、电脑显示器……这又是哪种全新的折磨？敬请期待11月12日揭晓答案。
《散落星海》试玩版现已上线Steam，将于2027年开启抢先体验
《散落星海》首个公开试玩版现已登陆Steam，游戏将于2027年以抢先体验形式推出！探索注定毁灭的世代飞船“佩格拉号”，在被密林吞噬的废墟中搜集资源、建立庇护所，并设法从曾摧毁祖先的灾难中幸存下来。
《潜水员戴夫》×《深海迷航2》联动DLC公开，将于2027年初上线
《潜水员戴夫》×《深海迷航2》联动DLC正式公开，将于2027年初登陆PC、PlayStation 4与5、Xbox与Nintendo Switch平台！来自外星海洋世界的新内容将进入巨型蓝洞，为戴夫的深海冒险带来全新惊喜。
《酒鬼女神的酒诡》试玩版将于10月19日上线，正式版12月8日发售
《晕晕电波症候群》开发团队新作《酒鬼女神的酒诡》正式公开，Steam试玩版将于10月19日上线，完整版预计12月8日发售！与深爱着你、甚至想杀掉你的Femme Soule展开一场危险的酒桌博弈，在扭曲规则中不断逼近真相。
《Escape the Backrooms》玩家数突破千万，全新更新“After Party”将于12月上线
《Escape the Backrooms》（逃离后室）玩家数正式突破1000万，全新更新“After Party”将于今年12月上线！为庆祝这一里程碑，游戏将于10月率先带来全新皮肤，更多后室冒险与惊喜内容即将公开。

《虚妄回响》试玩版现已登陆Steam，完整版将于2027年春季正式推出！登上高度机密的军用潜艇，截获神秘讯息并破解隐藏密码，在真假难辨的情报与危险命令之间做出判断。
Strange Scaffold新作《Gods With Badges》全球首曝
Strange Scaffold新作《Gods With Badges》全球首曝！在这款叙事策略游戏中，你将扮演一名身处反乌托邦都市的警察，通过剧情选择与回合制战斗决定他人的命运。关掉执法记录仪，还能解锁特殊对话与战斗选项——规则、权力与正义，都将由你的选择重新定义！
《闹鬼爪子》免费试玩版现已上线Steam
《闹鬼爪子》免费试玩版现已登陆Steam，并确认将登陆PlayStation、Xbox与Nintendo Switch平台！捏出属于你的小狗角色，与好友一起探索闹鬼豪宅，解开谜题、躲避怪物，并寻找失踪的主人。
《Hela：鼠鼠奇旅》试玩版已上线，正式版将于12月1日登陆PC与主机
《Hela：鼠鼠奇旅》试玩版现已登陆Steam、Epic Games Store与Microsoft Store，完整版将于2026年12月1日登陆PC与主机平台！跟随可爱的鼠鼠使魔穿梭于瑞典旷野，在森林、湖泊与林间小径中自由探索，用一个个小小的善意开启一段温暖治愈的冒险。
《哥布林小岛》首次公开测试现已登陆Steam
《哥布林小岛》首次公开测试现已登陆Steam！在这款生存建造游戏中，你将扮演哥布林，在小岛上采集资源、建设家园，并抵御不断来袭的人类入侵者。
中式心理恐怖新作《叫魂》全球首发，将于2027年推出
中式心理恐怖新作《叫魂》全球首发，预计于2027年登陆PC与PlayStation 5！本作是一款以90年代中国小镇为背景的电影化叙事心理恐怖游戏。你将扮演一名失去灵魂的归乡者，在白水县仙女镇寻找失落魂魄，并逐步揭开这座小镇走向终结的秘密。
《王国：两位君主》古埃及主题DLC《Pharaoh Lands》将于2026年上线
《王国：两位君主》全新古埃及主题DLC《Pharaoh Lands》正式公开，将于2026年登陆PC、主机与移动平台！踏入沙漠与金字塔交织的神秘国度，破解古老谜题、寻找失落神器，并在夜幕降临后迎战全新威胁，逐步夺回支离破碎的王国。
叙事卡牌构筑新作《断头牌局》全球首发，将于2027年春季登陆Steam
叙事卡牌构筑新作《断头牌局》全球首发，将于2027年春季登陆Steam！本作以法国大革命为背景，身陷牢狱的你只能靠手中的牌活过一个又一个夜晚，在赌上一切的牌局中寻找自己被关押的真相。

全球首发：血腥风格2D动作肉鸽游戏《食子之虎》（Little Prince Tyger）正式公布，游戏测试现已开放，持续至10月18日！你将在超过1000个单屏关卡中一路猎杀，依靠精准操作、快速反应与不断扩充的装备突破重重挑战。Steam愿望单现已开启。

《DEVOUR》创作者新作《白昼地狱》首轮Steam测试现已开放，完整版将于2027年夏季推出！在这款支持1至4人合作的生存恐怖游戏中，搜刮物资、制作装备、捕捉变异生物并将其转化为列车燃料，一路逃离被致命阳光与怪物吞噬的城市。

《警目如炬》首个公开试玩版现已登陆Steam！探索这座荒诞诡异的小镇，与形形色色的居民周旋，同时躲避巨型警察的监视。观察环境、利用身边的一切，想办法搭上缆索铁路逃出生天。

《Prison of Husks》全新试玩版现已登陆Steam，完整版将于2027年1月27日登陆PC与PlayStation 5！化身人偶，在如画卷般展开的亡者世界中寻找失散的挚爱，通过格挡、反击与枪械战斗杀出前路，并在彼此相连的区域中探索秘密与捷径。

《谜界：异常货运》试玩版现已上线Steam，游戏将于2027年登陆PC与主机平台！驾驶越野卡车深入一座被腐朽神明与堕落梦境笼罩的孤岛，规划路线、穿越险恶地形并运送被诅咒的货物。必要时离开驾驶室，寻找神秘遗物与被遗忘的真相，在越野驾驶与恐怖交织的旅途中继续前进。
